definition_short_en: Establish and maintain an accurate, detailed, and current inventory of all enterprise assets capable of storing or processing data, including end-user, mobile, network, IoT, and server devices.
classification_rationale: A specific safeguard requiring maintenance of an asset inventory; canonical asset inventory control mapping to SD-02.01.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and approve its cybersecurity strategy, with visible sponsorship and support from the head of the entity or an authorized delegate.
classification_rationale: A governance outcome requiring a documented, approved, and sponsored cybersecurity strategy; strategy and governance sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must execute a defined action plan to operationalize and apply the approved cybersecurity strategy across its programs and initiatives.
classification_rationale: An action plan executed to implement the strategy; a plan artifact within strategy and governance.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity strategy must be reviewed at planned intervals, or upon changes to relevant legislative and regulatory requirements, to keep it current and aligned.
classification_rationale: A required periodic review outcome for the strategy; governance requirement under strategy and governance.

definition_short_en: Establish a process to detect and address unauthorized assets on the network on at least a weekly basis, removing, quarantining, or authorizing them appropriately.
classification_rationale: A recurring process to handle unauthorized assets; process artifact tied to asset inventory management.

definition_short_en: Configuration standards for network security controls must be defined and implemented to establish consistent, hardened baselines for firewalls and related network protection mechanisms.
classification_rationale: A configuration standard/baseline for network security controls; standard artifact in network and comms security.

definition_short_en: All changes to network connections and to configurations of network security controls must be formally approved and managed through a controlled change process.
classification_rationale: A safeguard requiring approval and management of network configuration changes; preventive control in network security.

definition_short_en: Inbound traffic to the cardholder data environment must be restricted to only that which is necessary, blocking all other traffic to reduce exposure.
classification_rationale: A technical preventive safeguard restricting inbound network traffic to a sensitive environment; network and comms security.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically develop and approve a multi-channel cybersecurity awareness program to strengthen awareness of cyber threats and risks and build a positive security culture.
classification_rationale: An awareness program developed and approved; program artifact under awareness and training.

definition_short_en: The approved cybersecurity awareness program must be actively implemented and delivered to personnel across the entity to achieve intended behavioral outcomes.
classification_rationale: Implementation of the awareness program; program execution under awareness and training.

definition_short_en: The awareness program must cover protection against the latest cyber risks and threats, including secure handling of email services and recognition of phishing emails.
classification_rationale: A content requirement specifying awareness topics such as phishing; requirement under awareness and training.

definition_short_en: Specialized skills and necessary training must be provided to personnel in roles directly linked to cybersecurity to maintain adequate competency within the entity.
classification_rationale: A requirement to provide specialized training to cybersecurity personnel; competency requirement under awareness and training.

definition_short_en: The implementation of the cybersecurity awareness program must be periodically reviewed to assess effectiveness and drive continuous improvement across the entity.
classification_rationale: A periodic review requirement for the awareness program; assurance requirement under awareness and training.

definition_short_en: A dedicated cybersecurity department must be established within the entity to own, coordinate, and drive the organization's security program and functions.
classification_rationale: A governance outcome establishing an organizational cybersecurity function; strategy and governance requirement.

definition_short_en: All cybersecurity positions must be filled with full-time, qualified professionals meeting national eligibility requirements to ensure adequate and competent staffing.
classification_rationale: A requirement to staff security roles with qualified full-time professionals; governance staffing requirement.

definition_short_en: A cybersecurity supervisory committee must be established by the authorized official to ensure compliance with, support for, and monitoring of cybersecurity programs and regulations.
classification_rationale: A governance body established for oversight of cybersecurity; strategy and governance requirement.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity department must identify, document, approve, and communicate cybersecurity policies and procedures, including relevant controls and requirements, to relevant personnel and parties.
classification_rationale: A governing statement requiring documented, approved, communicated policies; policy artifact under policies and standards.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity department must ensure that documented cybersecurity policies and procedures, including relevant controls and requirements, are effectively implemented across the entity.
classification_rationale: A required outcome ensuring policies are implemented, not the policy document itself; requirement under policies and standards.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be supported by technical security standards such as firewall rule standards and configuration baselines to enable consistent implementation.
classification_rationale: Requires technical security standards to underpin policies; standard artifact under policies and standards.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be reviewed and updated at planned intervals, or upon changes to relevant legislative, regulatory requirements and standards.
classification_rationale: A periodic review and update requirement for policies; governance requirement under policies and standards.

definition_short_en: The authorized official must identify, document, and approve the cybersecurity governance structure, roles, and responsibilities, and assign the persons responsible for them.
classification_rationale: A governance requirement to define and assign security roles and responsibilities; strategy and governance.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities within the entity must be reviewed and updated at planned intervals, or upon changes to relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
classification_rationale: A periodic review requirement for roles and responsibilities; governance requirement under strategy and governance.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity department must identify, document, and approve a cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures reflecting confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and technology assets.
classification_rationale: Defines a documented risk management methodology and procedures; process artifact under risk management.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity department must implement the approved cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures consistently across the entity's operations and technology assets.
classification_rationale: A required outcome to implement the risk management methodology; risk-driven requirement under risk management.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity risk assessment procedures must be applied at least at the early stage of technology projects to identify and treat risks before implementation.
classification_rationale: Requires risk assessment early in technology projects; risk requirement under risk management.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures must be reviewed and updated at planned intervals or when relevant legislative, regulatory, or standards requirements change.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement mandating periodic review of the risk management methodology; maps to Risk Management sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements must be embedded in project management and IT asset change management processes to identify and manage cyber risks throughout the technology project lifecycle.
classification_rationale: Requirement to integrate security into project management and change lifecycle; aligns with AppSec Governance and SDLC.

definition_short_en: Project management and IT asset change cybersecurity requirements must include, as a minimum, vulnerability assessment and remediation for the entity's technology assets and projects.
classification_rationale: Mandates vulnerability assessment and remediation as a project requirement; maps to Vulnerability and Patch Management.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for software and application development projects must include, as a minimum, the use of secure coding standards within the entity.
classification_rationale: Requires secure coding standards in development projects; maps to Code, Components and Supply Chain.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity requirements applied to project management within the entity must be reviewed periodically to ensure continued adequacy and effectiveness.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement for periodic review of project security requirements; AppSec Governance and SDLC.

definition_short_en: Where nationally approved international agreements or commitments include cybersecurity requirements, the entity must identify and comply with those requirements.
classification_rationale: Conditional compliance requirement tied to applicable international agreements; maps to Compliance, Audit and Assurance.

definition_short_en: The entity's cybersecurity department must periodically review the implementation of cybersecurity controls across the entity to verify their effectiveness and compliance.
classification_rationale: Requirement for periodic internal review of control implementation; Compliance, Audit and Assurance.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity control implementation must be independently reviewed and audited by parties outside the cybersecurity department, following accepted auditing standards and conflict-of-interest principles.
classification_rationale: Requires independent third-party audit per GAAS; maps to Compliance, Audit and Assurance.

definition_short_en: Results of cybersecurity audits and reviews must be documented and presented to the cybersecurity supervisory committee and the Authorized Official for oversight.
classification_rationale: Requirement to document and report audit results to governance bodies; Compliance, Audit and Assurance.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for personnel must be identified, documented, and approved before, during, and upon the end or termination of their employment.
classification_rationale: Requirement to define personnel security requirements across the employment lifecycle; Insider and Personnel Security.

definition_short_en: The defined cybersecurity requirements for the entity's personnel must be implemented in practice across all stages of the employment relationship.
classification_rationale: Requirement to implement personnel cybersecurity requirements; Insider and Personnel Security.

definition_short_en: Pre-employment cybersecurity requirements must include personnel security responsibility and non-disclosure clauses in employment contracts, applying during and after employment end or termination.
classification_rationale: Requires contractual security and NDA clauses; maps to Legal, HR and Contracts.

definition_short_en: During employment, cybersecurity requirements for personnel must include cybersecurity awareness delivered during onboarding and throughout the employment relationship.
classification_rationale: Requires ongoing security awareness during employment; maps to Awareness and Training.

definition_short_en: Personnel powers and access privileges must be reviewed and revoked immediately upon the end or termination of their employment with the entity.
classification_rationale: Specific safeguard to revoke access at offboarding; Identity Lifecycle, preventive access control.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity requirements applicable to the entity's personnel must be reviewed periodically to maintain their adequacy and relevance.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement for periodic review of personnel security requirements; Insider and Personnel Security.

definition_short_en: The entity must establish and maintain a detailed inventory of all licensed software installed on enterprise assets to support control and oversight.
classification_rationale: Safeguard to maintain a software inventory; maps to Software and License management.

definition_short_en: Only currently supported software and components may be used in the enterprise; unsupported or out-of-date software must be updated or replaced.
classification_rationale: Preventive safeguard ensuring only supported, patchable software is used; Vulnerability and Patch Management.

definition_short_en: System components must be configured and managed securely, consistent with industry-accepted system hardening standards, to reduce exposure and attack surface.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive control for secure configuration per hardening standards; Configuration and Hardening.

definition_short_en: Vendor default accounts, passwords, and SNMP community strings must be changed before installing a system on the network to prevent unauthorized access.
classification_rationale: Preventive hardening control removing default credentials; maps to Configuration and Hardening.

definition_short_en: Only necessary services, protocols, daemons, and functions may be enabled; all unnecessary functionality must be removed or disabled to minimize attack surface.
classification_rationale: Preventive hardening control disabling unneeded services and protocols; Configuration and Hardening.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for managing the entity's information and technology assets must be identified, documented, and formally approved.
classification_rationale: Requirement to define and approve asset management security requirements; Asset Inventory.

definition_short_en: The defined cybersecurity requirements for managing the entity's information and technology assets must be implemented in operational practice.
classification_rationale: Requirement to implement asset management security requirements; Asset Inventory.

definition_short_en: The policy for acceptable use of the entity's information and technology assets must be identified, documented, approved, and communicated to relevant personnel.
classification_rationale: Governing acceptable use policy statement to be defined and communicated; policy artifact under Asset Inventory.

definition_short_en: The approved acceptable use policy for the entity's information and technology assets must be implemented and enforced in practice.
classification_rationale: Requirement to implement the acceptable use policy; Asset Inventory domain.

definition_short_en: Information and technology assets must be classified, labeled, and handled in accordance with the relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
classification_rationale: Safeguard to classify, label, and handle assets per regulation; maps to Data Classification.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements governing the management of the entity's information and technology assets must be reviewed on a periodic basis to ensure continued adequacy and coverage.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to periodically review asset-management requirements; maps to asset inventory domain at governance abstraction.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for managing technical vulnerabilities across the entity must be formally identified, documented, and approved by the appropriate authority before use.
classification_rationale: Requirement to establish, document, and approve vulnerability-management requirements; governance outcome in vulnerability and patch management.

definition_short_en: The defined cybersecurity requirements for technical vulnerability management must be operationally implemented across the entity's systems and environments.
classification_rationale: Requirement mandating implementation of vulnerability-management requirements; governance-level outcome in vulnerability and patch domain.

definition_short_en: Vulnerability management must include periodic assessment and detection of technical vulnerabilities to identify weaknesses across the entity's information assets before exploitation.
classification_rationale: Specific detective safeguard mandating recurring vulnerability scanning and detection; technical control in vulnerability and patch management.

definition_short_en: The implementation of the entity's technical vulnerability-management requirements must be periodically reviewed to confirm effectiveness and ongoing compliance.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement for periodic review of vulnerability-management implementation; assurance outcome in vulnerability domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for conducting penetration testing within the entity must be formally identified, documented, and approved by the relevant authority.
classification_rationale: Requirement to establish, document, and approve penetration-testing requirements; governance outcome in security testing and assessments.

definition_short_en: The defined penetration-testing requirements must be operationally implemented so that testing activities are actually performed across the entity.
classification_rationale: Requirement mandating implementation of penetration-testing requirements; governance-level outcome in security testing domain.

definition_short_en: Penetration testing scope must cover all externally provided internet services and components including infrastructure, websites, web and mobile applications, email, and remote access.
classification_rationale: Specific detective control defining mandatory scope of penetration testing over all internet-facing services; assessed manually.

definition_short_en: The implementation of the entity's penetration-testing requirements must be periodically reviewed to verify coverage, effectiveness, and compliance.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement for periodic review of penetration-testing implementation; assurance outcome in security testing domain.

title_en: Define Event Logging And Monitoring Requirements
definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for event logs and monitoring management within the entity must be formally identified, documented, and approved.
classification_rationale: Requirement to establish, document, and approve logging and monitoring requirements; governance outcome in logging and monitoring domain.

title_en: Implement Event Logging And Monitoring Requirements
definition_short_en: The defined cybersecurity requirements for event logging and monitoring management must be operationally implemented across the entity's systems.
classification_rationale: Requirement mandating implementation of logging and monitoring requirements; governance-level outcome in logging domain.

definition_short_en: Event logs must be activated for the entity's critical information assets so that security-relevant activity is captured and available for monitoring.
classification_rationale: Specific detective technical control mandating log activation on critical assets; verifiable through system configuration.

definition_short_en: The implementation of the entity's event logging and monitoring requirements must be periodically reviewed to confirm effectiveness and completeness.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement for periodic review of logging and monitoring implementation; assurance outcome in logging domain.

title_en: Define Incident And Threat Management Requirements
definition_short_en: Requirements for cybersecurity incident and threat management within the entity must be formally identified, documented, and approved by the relevant authority.
classification_rationale: Requirement to establish, document, and approve incident and threat management requirements; governance outcome in incident management.

title_en: Implement Incident And Threat Management Requirements
definition_short_en: The defined requirements for cybersecurity incident and threat management must be operationally implemented across the entity.
classification_rationale: Requirement mandating implementation of incident and threat management requirements; governance-level outcome in incident domain.

definition_short_en: Incident and threat management must include documented cybersecurity incident response plans and escalation procedures defining how incidents are handled and elevated.
classification_rationale: Mandates existence of incident response plans and escalation procedures; a plan artifact at procedural abstraction within incident management.

title_en: Review Incident And Threat Management Implementation
definition_short_en: The implementation of the entity's incident and threat management requirements must be periodically reviewed to verify readiness and effectiveness.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement for periodic review of incident and threat management implementation; assurance outcome in incident domain.

definition_short_en: Requirements to protect information and technology assets against unauthorized physical access, loss, theft, and damage must be identified, documented, and approved.
classification_rationale: Requirement to establish, document, and approve physical protection requirements; governance outcome in physical and environmental security.

definition_short_en: The defined requirements protecting assets against unauthorized physical access, loss, theft, and damage must be operationally implemented across the entity.
classification_rationale: Requirement mandating implementation of physical protection requirements; governance-level outcome in physical security domain.

definition_short_en: Physical security must enforce authorized access to critical areas such as data centers and server rooms to prevent unauthorized entry to sensitive facilities.
classification_rationale: Specific preventive physical control restricting access to critical areas like data centers; verified through manual inspection.

definition_short_en: The implementation of the entity's physical protection requirements against unauthorized access, loss, theft, and damage must be periodically reviewed.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement for periodic review of physical security implementation; assurance outcome in physical security domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting the entity's external web applications must be formally identified, documented, and approved by the relevant authority.
classification_rationale: Requirement to establish, document, and approve external web application protection requirements; governance outcome in AppSec governance.

definition_short_en: The defined requirements for protecting the entity's external web applications must be operationally implemented to safeguard those applications.
classification_rationale: Requirement mandating implementation of external web application protection requirements; governance-level outcome in AppSec domain.

definition_short_en: Web application protection must include the use of a web application firewall to filter and block malicious traffic targeting external web applications.
classification_rationale: Specific preventive technical control mandating a web application firewall to protect external web apps; verifiable through configuration.

definition_short_en: The implementation of the entity's web application protection requirements must be periodically reviewed to confirm effectiveness and compliance.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement for periodic review of web application protection implementation; assurance outcome in AppSec domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve its cybersecurity requirements governing identity and access management to ensure a defined and authorized basis for controlling user access.
classification_rationale: Requirement to define, document and approve IAM cybersecurity requirements; governance-level outcome in the identity domain, hence ART-REQ/ABS-GOV/SD-03.01.

title_en: Implement Identity and Access Management Requirements
definition_short_en: The entity must implement its documented and approved cybersecurity requirements for identity and access management so that defined access controls are operational across systems and users.
classification_rationale: Mandatory outcome requiring implementation of the defined IAM requirements; remains a governance-level requirement in the identity domain.

definition_short_en: As a minimum, identity and access management must enforce single-factor authentication based on a username and password before granting users access to the entity's systems.
classification_rationale: Specific authentication safeguard (username/password single-factor) is a technical preventive control mapped to Authentication and MFA sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of its identity and access management cybersecurity requirements to confirm continued effectiveness and compliance with approved requirements.
classification_rationale: Requirement to periodically review IAM implementation; an assurance-oriented governance requirement mapped to access review sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve cybersecurity requirements for protecting its information systems and processing facilities to establish an authorized baseline for safeguarding them.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to define and approve protection requirements for information systems and processing facilities; mapped to systems/servers/endpoint sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must implement its approved cybersecurity requirements for protecting information systems and processing facilities so that defined safeguards are operational across servers and workstations.
classification_rationale: Mandatory outcome requiring implementation of defined information system protection requirements; governance-level requirement in the systems/endpoint sub-domain.

title_en: Malware Protection on Endpoints and Servers
definition_short_en: As a minimum, the entity must protect workstations and servers from viruses, suspicious programs, and malware using modern, securely managed anti-malware technologies and mechanisms.
classification_rationale: Specific anti-malware safeguard on workstations and servers is a technical preventive control in the systems/servers/endpoint sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of cybersecurity requirements protecting its information systems and processing facilities to verify continued effectiveness and compliance.
classification_rationale: Requirement to periodically review implementation of systems protection; assurance-oriented governance requirement in systems/endpoint sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve cybersecurity requirements for protecting its email service, establishing an authorized baseline for securing email communications.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to define and approve email protection requirements; mapped to email/web/digital communications sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must implement its approved cybersecurity requirements for protecting the email service so that defined email security safeguards are operational.
classification_rationale: Mandatory outcome requiring implementation of defined email protection requirements; governance-level requirement in the email sub-domain.

title_en: Email Filtering for Phishing and Spam
definition_short_en: As a minimum, the entity must analyze and filter email messages, particularly phishing and spam, using modern and advanced email protection techniques and mechanisms.
classification_rationale: Specific email analysis and filtering safeguard against phishing and spam is a technical preventive control in the email sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of cybersecurity requirements for its email service to verify continued effectiveness and compliance with approved requirements.
classification_rationale: Requirement to periodically review email protection implementation; assurance-oriented governance requirement in the email sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve cybersecurity requirements for managing network security, establishing an authorized baseline for protecting its networks.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to define and approve network security management requirements; mapped to network and communications security sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must implement its approved cybersecurity requirements for network security management so that defined network protection safeguards are operational.
classification_rationale: Mandatory outcome requiring implementation of defined network security requirements; governance-level requirement in the network sub-domain.

definition_short_en: As a minimum, the entity must logically or physically isolate and segment network segments securely using firewalls and defense-in-depth principles to control relevant cybersecurity risks.
classification_rationale: Specific network segmentation and isolation safeguard using firewalls and defense-in-depth is a technical preventive control in the network sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of its network security management cybersecurity requirements to verify continued effectiveness and compliance with approved requirements.
classification_rationale: Requirement to periodically review network security implementation; assurance-oriented governance requirement in the network sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve cybersecurity requirements for mobile devices and BYOD security when such devices connect to the entity's network.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to define and approve mobile device and BYOD security requirements; mapped to systems/servers/endpoint sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must implement its approved cybersecurity requirements for mobile device and BYOD security so that defined protections apply to such devices.
classification_rationale: Mandatory outcome requiring implementation of defined mobile/BYOD security requirements; governance-level requirement in the endpoint sub-domain.

title_en: Encryption and Separation of Mobile Data
definition_short_en: As a minimum, the entity must separate and encrypt its data and information stored on mobile devices and BYODs to protect it from unauthorized access or loss.
classification_rationale: Specific safeguard separating and encrypting entity data on mobile/BYOD devices is a technical preventive control in the endpoint sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of its mobile device and BYOD security cybersecurity requirements to verify continued effectiveness and compliance.
classification_rationale: Requirement to periodically review mobile/BYOD security implementation; assurance-oriented governance requirement in the endpoint sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve cybersecurity requirements for protecting and handling its data and information in line with relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to define data protection requirements aligned to legislative and regulatory obligations; regulatory-driven requirement in the data protection sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must implement its cybersecurity requirements for protecting data and information based on each item's classification level, ensuring protection commensurate with sensitivity.
classification_rationale: Mandatory outcome requiring implementation of data protection according to classification level; governance requirement in the data protection sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of its cybersecurity requirements for protecting data and information to verify continued effectiveness and compliance.
classification_rationale: Requirement to periodically review data protection implementation; assurance-oriented governance requirement in the data protection sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve cybersecurity requirements for cryptography, establishing an authorized baseline for the use of encryption within the entity.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to define and approve cryptography requirements; mapped to data protection and encryption sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must implement its approved cybersecurity requirements for cryptography so that encryption controls are operational to protect the confidentiality and integrity of information.
classification_rationale: Mandatory outcome requiring implementation of defined cryptography requirements; governance-level requirement in the encryption sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for cryptography must incorporate, at minimum, the provisions defined in the National Cryptographic Standards issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA).
classification_rationale: A mandated outcome aligning cryptography requirements to a regulatory standard (NCA), making it a regulatory requirement rather than a mechanism; maps to data protection and encryption.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of its cybersecurity requirements for cryptography to confirm ongoing effectiveness and continued compliance with applicable standards.
classification_rationale: A periodic review safeguard verifying cryptography implementation; organizational detective control evidenced by documentation, mapped to data protection and encryption.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve its cybersecurity requirements governing backup and recovery management to establish a sanctioned basis for resilience activities.
classification_rationale: A governance outcome requiring backup requirements to be defined, documented, and approved; requirement type governance, mapped to disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: The entity must implement its documented cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management so that backup capabilities operate effectively in practice across critical assets.
classification_rationale: A mandated outcome requiring implementation of backup requirements; governance requirement mapped to disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: Backup and recovery requirements must, at minimum, define a scope covering critical technology and information assets to ensure essential data is recoverable after loss.
classification_rationale: Specifies the minimum scope of backups as a required outcome; standards-based requirement mapped to disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of its backup and recovery management requirements to verify they remain effective and aligned with current resilience needs.
classification_rationale: A periodic review safeguard verifying backup implementation; organizational detective control evidenced by documentation, mapped to disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a data management process addressing data sensitivity, ownership, handling, retention limits, and disposal requirements to govern data throughout its lifecycle.
classification_rationale: A defined process spanning data sensitivity, handling, retention, and disposal; classified as a process mapped to privacy, retention, and disposal. Bundles multiple ideas so needs_split.

definition_short_en: Account data storage must be minimized through defined retention and disposal policies, procedures, and processes, reducing exposure by limiting how long data is kept.
classification_rationale: A safeguard minimizing retained account data via retention/disposal; preventive organizational control mapped to privacy, retention, and disposal.

definition_short_en: Configure data access control lists based on each user's need to know, applying the least privilege principle so users receive only the access strictly required.
classification_rationale: A technical safeguard configuring ACLs on need-to-know and least privilege; preventive control mapped to authorization and least privilege.

definition_short_en: Sensitive Authentication Data must not be retained after authorization completes, even when encrypted, eliminating high-risk cardholder authentication data from stored records.
classification_rationale: A preventive safeguard prohibiting retention of sensitive authentication data post-authorization; technical control mapped to data retention and disposal.

definition_short_en: The Primary Account Number must be masked when displayed, revealing at most the first six and last four digits to limit exposure of full card numbers.
classification_rationale: A technical safeguard masking displayed PAN to limit disclosure; preventive control mapped to data protection and encryption.

definition_short_en: Stored Primary Account Number data must be rendered unreadable everywhere it resides using strong cryptography together with associated key-management processes.
classification_rationale: A technical safeguard rendering stored PAN unreadable via strong cryptography and key management; preventive control mapped to data protection and encryption.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify, document, and formally approve its cybersecurity requirements for business continuity management to establish an authorized foundation for continuity planning.
classification_rationale: A governance outcome requiring continuity requirements to be defined, documented, and approved; governance requirement mapped to business continuity.

definition_short_en: The entity must implement its documented cybersecurity requirements for business continuity management so continuity capabilities function effectively during disruptions.
classification_rationale: A mandated outcome requiring implementation of continuity requirements; governance requirement mapped to business continuity.

definition_short_en: Business continuity requirements must, at minimum, ensure the continuity of cybersecurity systems and procedures so security protection persists through disruptive events.
classification_rationale: Specifies a minimum outcome ensuring continuity of security systems and procedures; standards-based requirement mapped to business continuity.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically review the implementation of its business continuity management requirements to confirm they remain effective and current.
classification_rationale: A periodic review safeguard verifying continuity implementation; organizational detective control evidenced by documentation, mapped to business continuity.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process for enterprise assets and software, reviewing and updating the supporting documentation at least annually.
classification_rationale: A maintained process for secure configuration of assets and software with annual review; process mapped to configuration and hardening. Title corrected from mislabeled source.

definition_short_en: Strong cryptography and security protocols must be implemented to safeguard the Primary Account Number during transmission over open, public networks.
classification_rationale: A technical safeguard using strong cryptography and protocols to protect PAN in transit over public networks; preventive control mapped to network and communications security.

definition_short_en: The Primary Account Number must be secured with strong cryptography whenever sent via end-user messaging technologies such as email, instant messaging, SMS, or chat.
classification_rationale: A technical safeguard encrypting PAN sent through end-user messaging channels; preventive control mapped to email, web, and digital communications.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain an inventory of all accounts managed across the enterprise, including user, administrator, and service accounts, to enable oversight and control.
classification_rationale: A safeguard maintaining a complete inventory of user, admin, and service accounts; detective control supporting identity lifecycle. Title corrected from truncated source.

definition_short_en: Use unique passwords for every enterprise asset and avoid reusing the same password across multiple assets to contain credential compromise.
classification_rationale: A safeguard enforcing unique, non-reused passwords per asset; preventive control mapped to authentication. Title corrected from mislabeled source.

definition_short_en: Anti-malware software must be deployed on all system components, except those identified in periodic evaluations as not at risk for malware, providing broad protection.
classification_rationale: A technical safeguard deploying anti-malware across system components; detective control mapped to systems, servers, and endpoint security.

definition_short_en: Dormant accounts must be disabled after 45 days of inactivity, where supported, reducing the attack surface from unused and forgotten accounts.
classification_rationale: A safeguard disabling inactive accounts after a set threshold; preventive control mapped to identity lifecycle. Title condensed from source text.

definition_short_en: Establish and follow a preferably automated process for granting access to enterprise assets upon new hire, rights grant, or user role change.
classification_rationale: A defined, preferably automated process for granting access on hire, grant, or role change; process mapped to identity lifecycle. Title corrected from mislabeled source.

definition_short_en: Software-development personnel must be trained in software security, including secure coding techniques, in accordance with industry best practices and organizational requirements.
classification_rationale: A human-oriented safeguard training developers in secure coding; preventive control mapped to AppSec governance and SDLC. Title corrected from truncated source.

definition_short_en: Require multi-factor authentication for all external or remote connections into the enterprise network, including VPN access, to prevent compromise of credentials from remote entry points.
classification_rationale: Specific technical safeguard enforcing MFA on remote/VPN access; maps to authentication sub-domain SD-03.02.

definition_short_en: Security vulnerabilities across enterprise assets must be identified, assessed, and managed on an ongoing basis to reduce the likelihood and impact of exploitation.
classification_rationale: High-level required outcome (identify and manage vulnerabilities) rather than a specific mechanism; vulnerability management sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Require multi-factor authentication for all administrative access to enterprise assets to protect high-privilege accounts against credential theft and unauthorized privileged use.
classification_rationale: MFA safeguard specifically for administrative/privileged access; privileged access sub-domain SD-03.04. Title mismatched in source.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a documented vulnerability management process for enterprise assets, reviewing and updating documentation annually or when significant enterprise changes occur.
classification_rationale: Establishes a maintained process for vulnerability management; process artifact in vulnerability/patch management sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a risk-based remediation strategy, documented in a remediation process and reviewed monthly or more frequently, to prioritize fixing identified vulnerabilities.
classification_rationale: Documented remediation process with periodic review; process artifact in vulnerability/patch remediation sub-domain.

definition_short_en: An access control system restricts access to system components and the cardholder data environment based on need-to-know and is configured to deny all access by default.
classification_rationale: Technical access control enforcing least-privilege/need-to-know with default-deny; authorization and least-privilege sub-domain SD-03.03.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain an audit log management process that defines the enterprise's logging requirements across systems and assets to support monitoring and investigation.
classification_rationale: Process defining enterprise logging requirements; logging and monitoring sub-domain SD-06.01.

definition_short_en: Collect audit logs and ensure logging, per the enterprise's audit log management process, is enabled across all enterprise assets to capture security-relevant events.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard enabling and collecting logs across assets; detective control in logging sub-domain. Title mismatched in source.

definition_short_en: All user access to system components must be authenticated via at least one factor such as password, token, smart card, or biometrics before access is granted.
classification_rationale: Authentication safeguard requiring at least one factor for user access; authentication sub-domain SD-03.02.

definition_short_en: Multi-factor authentication is implemented for all access into the cardholder data environment to strengthen protection of systems handling payment card data.
classification_rationale: MFA safeguard for all access into the CDE; authentication/MFA sub-domain SD-03.02.

title_en: Approved Supported Browsers and Email Clients
definition_short_en: Ensure only fully supported browsers and email clients that have been approved by the enterprise are used, reducing exposure from outdated or unauthorized client software.
classification_rationale: Safeguard restricting to approved/supported browsers and email clients; email, web and digital comms sub-domain SD-04.05.

definition_short_en: Physical access to sensitive areas is restricted to authorized personnel only, preventing unauthorized individuals from entering facilities housing critical systems or data.
classification_rationale: Physical safeguard restricting access to sensitive areas; physical and environmental sub-domain SD-08.04.

definition_short_en: Deploy and maintain anti-malware software on all enterprise assets to detect, prevent, and remediate malicious code across endpoints and servers.
classification_rationale: Technical anti-malware safeguard on enterprise assets/endpoints; systems, servers and endpoint sub-domain SD-04.02.

definition_short_en: Configure automatic updates for anti-malware signature files on all enterprise assets on a daily or more frequent basis to maintain detection of current threats.
classification_rationale: Technical configuration ensuring daily anti-malware signature updates; endpoint protection sub-domain SD-04.02.

definition_short_en: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data access, ensuring security-relevant events are continuously recorded.
classification_rationale: Detective safeguard ensuring logs enabled for all components and CDE access; logging sub-domain SD-06.01.

definition_short_en: Audit logs are reviewed for anomalies or suspicious activity using automated mechanisms to enable timely detection of potential security incidents.
classification_rationale: Detective control using automated mechanisms to review logs for anomalies; threat detection and alerts sub-domain SD-06.02.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a data recovery process addressing the scope of recovery activities, recovery prioritization, and the security of backup data.
classification_rationale: Documented data recovery process covering scope, prioritization, and backup security; disaster recovery and resilience sub-domain SD-07.04.

definition_short_en: Perform automated backups of in-scope enterprise assets, running weekly or more frequently based on the sensitivity of the data to enable recovery.
classification_rationale: Technical recovery safeguard performing automated periodic backups; DR and resilience sub-domain SD-07.04. Title mismatched in source.

definition_short_en: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months to identify weaknesses in internal systems for timely remediation.
classification_rationale: Detective safeguard performing periodic internal vulnerability scans; vulnerability and patch management sub-domain SD-06.03.

definition_short_en: Ensure network infrastructure is kept up-to-date by running the latest stable software releases or using currently supported network-infrastructure-as-a-service offerings.
classification_rationale: Safeguard maintaining current, supported network infrastructure software; network and comms security sub-domain SD-04.01.

definition_short_en: An overall information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated to all relevant personnel to govern the enterprise's security posture.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement established, published, and disseminated; policies and standards sub-domain SD-01.02.

definition_short_en: Centralize security event alerting across enterprise assets for log correlation and analysis, ideally using a SIEM to support timely detection and response.
classification_rationale: Detective safeguard centralizing event alerting/correlation via SIEM; threat detection and alerts sub-domain SD-06.02. Title mismatched in source.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a security awareness program to educate the workforce on interacting with enterprise assets and data in a secure manner.
classification_rationale: Security awareness program educating the workforce; awareness and training sub-domain SD-08.01. Title mismatched in source.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain an inventory of service providers listing all known providers, including classifications and a designated enterprise contact for each provider.
classification_rationale: Maintained inventory of service providers with classification and contacts; third-party and supply risk sub-domain SD-08.03.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a secure software development process with acceptance criteria such as peer code review and threat modeling to build security into applications.
classification_rationale: Secure development process including peer review and threat modeling acceptance criteria; AppSec governance and SDLC sub-domain SD-05.01.

definition_short_en: Designate a primary responsible individual and at least one backup to own and manage the enterprise incident handling process, ensuring clear accountability and coverage during security events.
classification_rationale: Assigns named ownership and backup for incident handling; an ownership designation (ART-OWN) governing the incident management sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a penetration testing program scaled to the enterprise size and complexity, systematically identifying exploitable weaknesses across systems, networks, and applications through simulated attacks.
classification_rationale: Broad penetration testing program maps to security testing and assessments (SD-06.04); a program artifact tailored to enterprise scale.

definition_short_en: Defines acceptable use of equipment and computing services and the security measures employees must observe to protect corporate resources and proprietary information from misuse or compromise.
classification_rationale: A governing policy statement on acceptable use of assets; classified as ART-POL under policies and standards governance.

definition_short_en: Ensure an access control decision is evaluated and applied to every access request before access enforcement occurs, preventing unauthorized access to protected resources.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive safeguard enforcing authorization decisions per request; maps to authorization and least-privilege sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Defines rules for granting access to corporate systems and data on a least-privilege basis, including periodic access reviews and prompt revocation of access upon employment termination.
classification_rationale: A governing policy for least-privilege access, reviews, and revocation; ART-POL in authorization and least-privilege. Bundles reviews and revocation but primary idea is the access policy.

definition_short_en: Establish and follow a preferably automated process for granting access to enterprise assets upon new hire, rights grant, or user role change, aligning access with role requirements.
classification_rationale: A process for granting access across identity lifecycle events (hire, role change); maps to identity lifecycle (SD-03.01) as a process artifact.

definition_short_en: The organization must define and apply access rights reviews across all in-scope assets, systems, processes, and parties to ensure entitlements remain appropriate and authorized over time.
classification_rationale: A governance requirement mandating access rights reviews across scope; maps to access review and federation (SD-03.05) as ART-REQ.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain an inventory of all accounts managed in the enterprise, including user, administrator, and service accounts, to enable governance and detection of unauthorized accounts.
classification_rationale: Maintaining an account inventory is an organizational detective control supporting identity lifecycle management (SD-03.01).

definition_short_en: Configure account lockout thresholds to mitigate brute-force credential attacks, for example locking accounts after five failed authentication attempts for fifteen minutes before automatic reset.
classification_rationale: A specific configuration baseline for lockout thresholds defending authentication; ART-CFG under authentication and MFA (SD-03.02).

definition_short_en: Configure Active Directory account lockout policy to mitigate brute-force credential attacks, for example locking accounts after five failed attempts for fifteen minutes to slow automated guessing.
classification_rationale: Active Directory-specific lockout configuration baseline defending authentication; ART-CFG under authentication and MFA (SD-03.02).

definition_short_en: Restrict Domain Admin account use strictly to Domain Controllers and apply a tiered administration model to prevent lateral movement and limit exposure of high-privilege credentials.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive control constraining privileged Domain Admin use via tiering; maps to privileged access (SD-03.04).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may actively scan victim systems and networks for exploitable vulnerabilities during targeting, gathering reconnaissance information to plan subsequent intrusion and exploitation activity.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique (active scanning) rather than a safeguard; classified as ART-THR in the risk abstraction, aligned with vulnerability management context.

definition_short_en: Identify an alternate processing site sufficiently separated from the primary site to reduce susceptibility to the same threats, enabling continued operations if the primary becomes unavailable.
classification_rationale: Recovery control providing a geographically separated alternate site; maps to disaster recovery and resilience (SD-07.04).

definition_short_en: Provide an alternate power supply that activates to maintain minimally required operational capability during an extended loss of the primary power source, sustaining critical system availability.
classification_rationale: Physical recovery control providing backup power for continued operations; maps to physical and environmental security (SD-08.04).

definition_short_en: Identify potential accessibility problems to the alternate storage site during area-wide disruptions or disasters and define explicit mitigation actions to ensure the site remains reachable when needed.
classification_rationale: Planning activity to anticipate and mitigate alternate-site access issues; ART-PLN under disaster recovery and resilience (SD-07.04).

definition_short_en: Periodically test alternate telecommunication services to confirm they function correctly and can sustain communications during a disruption of primary telecommunication links.
classification_rationale: A recurring test task validating alternate telecom resilience; ART-TSK under disaster recovery and resilience (SD-07.04).

definition_short_en: During incident response, the magnitude and scope of an incident are estimated and validated to prioritize response actions and allocate appropriate resources proportionate to impact.
classification_rationale: An incident response task to size and validate incident impact; ART-TSK under incident management (SD-07.01).

definition_short_en: Train personnel to detect counterfeit system components including hardware, software, and firmware, reducing supply chain risk from fraudulent or tampered parts entering enterprise assets.
classification_rationale: Human detective control training staff to spot counterfeit components; supply chain risk maps to third-party and supply risk (SD-08.03).

definition_short_en: Configure automatic anti-malware signature updates on all enterprise assets on a daily or more frequent basis to maintain current detection capability against emerging malware threats.
classification_rationale: A configuration baseline enforcing daily signature updates on endpoints; ART-CFG under systems, servers, and endpoint (SD-04.02).

definition_short_en: Deploy and maintain anti-malware software on all enterprise assets to prevent, detect, and remediate malicious software across endpoints and servers throughout the organization.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive control deploying anti-malware across all assets; maps to systems, servers, and endpoint (SD-04.02).

definition_short_en: Anti-malware software is deployed on all system components except those identified in periodic evaluations as not at risk for malware, ensuring risk-based coverage across the environment.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive control mandating anti-malware on all at-risk components; maps to systems, servers, and endpoint (SD-04.02).

definition_short_en: Implement an application vetting process to evaluate mobile apps for security and privacy flaws before deployment, preventing insecure or malicious applications from entering the environment.
classification_rationale: A process evaluating mobile apps for security and privacy flaws before deployment; maps to app and API security testing (SD-05.02).

definition_short_en: Develop and maintain an enterprise architecture that considers information security, privacy, and resulting risk to organizational operations, assets, individuals, and other stakeholders throughout the environment.
classification_rationale: Organizational control to build a security- and privacy-aware enterprise architecture; maps to strategy and governance (SD-01.01).

definition_short_en: Maintain a comprehensive inventory of assets including endpoints, servers, software, and cloud, each with an assigned owner and classification, forming the foundation for downstream security controls.
classification_rationale: Comprehensive asset inventory with owner and classification; maps to asset inventory (SD-02.01) as an organizational detective control.

definition_short_en: Information and technology assets must be classified, labeled, and handled in accordance with relevant legislative and regulatory requirements to ensure appropriate protection based on sensitivity.
classification_rationale: A regulatory-driven requirement to classify, label, and handle assets per legal requirements; maps to data classification (SD-02.03) as ART-REQ.

definition_short_en: Record and audit the actions and outcomes of content filtering mechanisms, capturing details about the information being filtered to support monitoring and accountability of filtering decisions.
classification_rationale: Technical detective safeguard that logs filtering activity; maps to logging and monitoring under Detection domain.

definition_short_en: Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of audit records and audit tools, preventing unauthorized modification or tampering of logged security events and logging infrastructure.
classification_rationale: Preventive technical control using cryptography to safeguard log integrity; belongs to logging and monitoring.

definition_short_en: Allocate and provision sufficient audit log storage capacity to accommodate defined retention and volume requirements, ensuring logging continuity and preventing loss of records due to exhausted storage.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard ensuring adequate storage for logs; supports logging and monitoring continuity.

definition_short_en: Ensure the auditd service is installed, enabled, and configured with rules recording events that modify date/time, user/group, and network environment information on the system.
classification_rationale: Specific host configuration baseline for the auditd daemon; a technical hardening configuration artifact.

definition_short_en: Enable and keep active audit logs for all system components and for access to cardholder data, ensuring security-relevant activity across the environment is captured for review.
classification_rationale: Detective technical control enabling logging across all components and sensitive data access; core logging and monitoring.

definition_short_en: Retain audit records for a defined period to support after-the-fact incident investigations and to satisfy regulatory and organizational information retention obligations.
classification_rationale: Control governing how long logs are kept for investigations and compliance; supports logging and monitoring.

title_en: Automated Audit Record Review and Analysis
definition_short_en: Review and analyze audit records using automated mechanisms to identify anomalies or suspicious activity, and report findings to support timely detection of potential security incidents.
classification_rationale: Detective control analyzing logs for anomalies via automation; aligns with threat detection and alerts.

definition_short_en: Authenticate all user access to system components using at least one accepted factor such as password/passphrase, token, smart card, or biometrics before granting access.
classification_rationale: Preventive technical control requiring authentication of all user access; maps to authentication sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse authentication packages to execute malicious DLLs automatically when the system boots, achieving persistence and privileged code execution on compromised hosts.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique (ATT&CK-style) rather than a safeguard; classified as a threat at risk abstraction.

definition_short_en: Verify the application supports multiple identity providers and ensures a user's identity cannot be spoofed or impersonated through any other supported identity provider during federated authentication.
classification_rationale: Preventive control for multi-IdP federation guarding against identity spoofing; maps to access review and federation.

definition_short_en: Ensure the app performs local authentication such as biometrics or PIN securely and validates credentials against a remote endpoint where applicable to prevent local bypass.
classification_rationale: Preventive technical control on secure mobile local authentication and remote validation; maps to authentication.

definition_short_en: Perform automated backups of in-scope enterprise assets at least weekly, or more frequently based on data sensitivity, to ensure recoverable copies of critical information exist.
classification_rationale: Recovery control performing automated periodic backups of assets; maps to disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: Detect the presence of unauthorized hardware, software, and firmware components within the system and take defined action to remediate or contain them when detected.
classification_rationale: Detective control identifying rogue hardware/software/firmware against inventory; maps to asset inventory.

definition_short_en: Use automated tools to determine whether system components have applicable security-relevant software and firmware updates installed, providing visibility into patch and remediation status.
classification_rationale: Detective control checking patch installation status via automation; maps to vulnerability and patch management.

definition_short_en: Employ automated tools that generate notifications upon discovering discrepancies during integrity verification, enabling prompt awareness and response to potential unauthorized system changes.
classification_rationale: Detective control alerting on integrity check discrepancies; aligns with threat detection and alerts.

definition_short_en: Support the management of system accounts using automated mechanisms to streamline provisioning, modification, disabling, and removal while reducing manual errors in the identity lifecycle.
classification_rationale: Technical control automating account lifecycle management; maps to identity lifecycle sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Employ automated tools and mechanisms to support near real-time analysis of security events, enabling faster identification and correlation of anomalous or malicious activity.
classification_rationale: Detective control for automated near real-time event analysis; aligns with threat detection and alerts.

definition_short_en: Enforce a limit on consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user within a defined time period, locking the account to deter automated password guessing and brute-force attacks.
classification_rationale: Preventive control limiting failed logon attempts to thwart brute force; maps to authentication.

definition_short_en: Provide personnel with awareness and training so they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks appropriately considered and mitigated.
classification_rationale: Ongoing personnel awareness and training initiative; classified as a program under awareness and training.

definition_short_en: Verify that communications between backend application components not covered by the application's standard user session mechanism are mutually authenticated to prevent unauthorized inter-service access.
classification_rationale: Preventive control authenticating backend service-to-service communication; maps to AppSec governance and SDLC.

definition_short_en: Screen individuals through background checks and vetting prior to authorizing their access to the system, reducing insider risk from unsuitable or malicious personnel.
classification_rationale: Human preventive control screening staff before granting access; maps to insider and personnel security.

definition_short_en: Define backup and recovery management requirements that at minimum scope backups to cover critical technology and information assets, ensuring essential data can be restored.
classification_rationale: States a required minimum backup scope outcome for critical assets; a governance requirement under disaster recovery.

definition_short_en: Identify an alternate storage site sufficiently geographically separated from the primary storage site to reduce susceptibility to the same threats affecting both locations simultaneously.
classification_rationale: Recovery control establishing a separated alternate backup site for resilience; maps to disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: Test restoration from backups periodically to guarantee that recovery procedures work and that backed-up data can be reliably restored when needed after an incident.
classification_rationale: Recovery control validating restore capability through periodic testing; maps to disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may buy, lease, or rent a network of compromised systems, a botnet, to leverage during targeting operations such as distributed attacks or infrastructure for campaigns.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary capability-acquisition technique rather than a safeguard; classified as threat under threat intel.

definition_short_en: Defines security requirements governing how employees may use personally owned devices to access corporate email, data, and systems while protecting organizational information.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement setting rules for personal devices accessing corporate systems; endpoint/device focus places it in SD-04.02.

title_en: HTTP Strict Transport Security Header Enforcement
definition_short_en: Requires that a Strict-Transport-Security response header be present on all responses to enforce HSTS, ensuring browsers only connect over encrypted HTTPS channels.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive safeguard enforcing HSTS via a web response header; testable automatically, mapped to web/digital communications security.

definition_short_en: Mandates that business continuity management incorporate cybersecurity requirements as a minimum, ensuring the continuity of security systems and procedures during disruptive events.
classification_rationale: Required outcome that BCM include cybersecurity continuity; governance-level requirement in the business continuity sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Requires planning for the resumption of mission and business functions within a defined recovery time following activation of the contingency or continuity plan.
classification_rationale: Required outcome to plan resumption of business functions within defined timeframes; business continuity governance requirement.

definition_short_en: Requires that a business continuity management strategy be formally developed and documented to guide organizational resilience and recovery planning efforts.
classification_rationale: Required outcome to develop and document a BCM strategy; governance-level continuity requirement.

definition_short_en: Verifies the application processes business logic flows only in the expected sequential step order for each user, preventing step skipping or out-of-order execution.
classification_rationale: Technical application safeguard enforcing correct business logic sequencing; verified through application security testing.

title_en: Cardholder Data Environment Inbound Traffic Restriction
definition_short_en: Restricts inbound network traffic to the cardholder data environment so that only traffic strictly necessary for CDE operations is permitted, blocking all other connections.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive network safeguard restricting inbound traffic to a sensitive environment; network and communications security.

definition_short_en: Requires appointment of a senior privacy official with authority, accountability, and resources to develop and implement privacy requirements and manage organization-wide privacy risks.
classification_rationale: Establishes accountability/ownership by appointing a senior privacy official; governance-level role assignment for the privacy program.

definition_short_en: Centralizes security event alerting across enterprise assets to enable log correlation and analysis, recommending a SIEM platform to aggregate and analyze events.
classification_rationale: Technical detective safeguard centralizing alerting and log correlation via SIEM; logging and monitoring sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Provides and implements a centralized management capability governing the content of audit records generated by individual system components across the enterprise.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard providing centralized control of audit record content; supports detective logging capability.

definition_short_en: Employs centrally managed integrity verification tools to detect unauthorized modifications to systems, software, and files across the organization's infrastructure.
classification_rationale: Technical detective safeguard using centrally managed integrity verification (file/system integrity monitoring) to identify unauthorized changes.

definition_short_en: Requires developers and installers of system components to supply unique authenticators or change default authenticators prior to delivery and installation of the systems.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive hardening safeguard eliminating default credentials before deployment; configuration and hardening sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Requires all changes to network connections and to configurations of network security controls to be formally approved and managed through a controlled change process.
classification_rationale: Organizational preventive control ensuring approval and management of network connection and security control changes.

definition_short_en: Ensures sensitive and confidential information in paper or electronic form is secured in the workspace when the user leaves their desk or at the end of the day.
classification_rationale: Governing policy requiring physical securing of sensitive information at unattended workspaces; physical and environmental security.

definition_short_en: Describes how adversaries may create accounts with cloud providers to establish infrastructure and resources used during the targeting and staging of attacks.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique (threat) around cloud account creation for targeting; risk-level cloud platform entry.

definition_short_en: Restricts the geographic location of information processing and data storage to facilities located within defined legal jurisdictional boundaries to maintain data sovereignty.
classification_rationale: Preventive control restricting data hosting geography for sovereignty; cloud and virtual platform sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Requires an organizational risk assessment before acquiring or outsourcing information security services or cloud providers to evaluate third-party security posture and exposure.
classification_rationale: Organizational preventive control assessing risk before outsourcing security services to cloud providers; third-party risk sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Requires that cybersecurity requirements for the use of cloud computing and hosting services be identified, documented, and formally approved before adoption.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to identify, document, and approve cloud security requirements; cloud platform sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Describes how an adversary may use a cloud service dashboard interface with stolen credentials to gather useful information from an operational cloud environment.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique using stolen credentials against cloud dashboards; risk-level threat in cloud platform.

definition_short_en: Identifies unauthorized software and enforces an allow-all, deny-by-exception policy to prohibit execution of unauthorized programs on organizational systems.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive application-control safeguard prohibiting execution of unauthorized software; configuration and hardening.

definition_short_en: Describes how adversaries may modify code signing policies to enable execution of unsigned or self-signed code, bypassing integrity and trust controls on systems.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique subverting code signing policy to run untrusted code; risk-level threat.

definition_short_en: Describes how adversaries may use a connection proxy to direct traffic between systems or act as an intermediary for communications to a command and control server.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary command-and-control proxy technique; risk-level threat relevant to threat detection and alerting.

definition_short_en: Describes how adversaries may clear the command history of a compromised account to conceal actions undertaken during an intrusion and evade detection.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary defense-evasion technique clearing command history to hide intrusion activity; risk-level threat.

definition_short_en: Describes how adversaries may use an external proxy to act as an intermediary for network communications to a command and control server, masking the true destination.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary external-proxy command-and-control technique; risk-level threat relevant to threat detection.

definition_short_en: Requires establishing a cybersecurity supervisory committee under the entity's authorized official to ensure compliance with, support for, and monitoring of cybersecurity programs and regulations.
classification_rationale: Establishes governance ownership by forming a cybersecurity supervisory committee to oversee compliance and program implementation.

definition_short_en: The entity must identify and comply with cybersecurity requirements arising from nationally approved international agreements or commitments that impose obligations relevant to the organization.
classification_rationale: Conditional requirement to identify and comply with legally binding international cybersecurity commitments; compliance/assurance domain, legal requirement type.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may modify component firmware to establish persistence on systems, embedding malicious code below the operating system to survive reboots and evade detection.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique describing firmware modification for persistence; a threat artifact affecting endpoints/servers rather than a control.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may manipulate application software before it reaches the final consumer, injecting malicious code to compromise data or systems through the supply chain.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique tampering with software before delivery; threat artifact in code/components/supply chain sub-domain.
