definition_short_en: A concept of operations describing how the system is intended to be used and operated must be developed and documented to guide secure design and deployment decisions.
classification_rationale: Documented concept of operations planning artifact supporting secure system development lifecycle governance.

definition_short_en: Employ concealment and misdirection techniques such as deception and decoys to confuse and mislead adversaries, increasing attacker cost and revealing malicious activity.
classification_rationale: Deception safeguard to mislead adversaries; deterrent technical control aligned with threat detection.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process for enterprise assets and software, and review and update the supporting documentation at least annually.
classification_rationale: Ongoing configuration management process for assets and software with annual documentation review; configuration and hardening sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Downgrade system media containing controlled unclassified information prior to public release, sanitizing sensitive content to prevent unauthorized disclosure of protected data.
classification_rationale: Preventive control sanitizing media before release; data disposal/retention sub-domain protecting controlled unclassified information.

definition_short_en: Verify that application cookies have the Secure attribute set so they are only transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections, preventing exposure over cleartext channels.
classification_rationale: Testable application safeguard ensuring cookies use the Secure attribute; app/API security testing preventive control.

title_en: Coordinate Contingency Plan with Related Plans
definition_short_en: Coordinate contingency plan development with organizational elements responsible for related plans to ensure alignment, avoid gaps, and support consistent recovery efforts.
classification_rationale: Organizational control coordinating contingency planning with related plans; business continuity sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Coordinate with external organizations to correlate and share incident information, achieving cross-organization situational awareness and enabling more effective and coordinated incident responses.
classification_rationale: Organizational control coordinating incident information sharing across organizations; incident management sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Measure the bandwidth of covert channels in the operational environment of the system to assess and limit unauthorized information flows that could exfiltrate sensitive data.
classification_rationale: Detective analysis measuring covert channel bandwidth; security testing and assessment sub-domain.

definition_short_en: An adversary may create a snapshot or data backup within a cloud account to evade defenses, capturing data or preparing infrastructure for later malicious use.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique creating cloud snapshots to evade defenses; threat artifact in cloud/virtual platform sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials from operating systems or software to obtain account login and credential material for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique harvesting credential material; threat artifact aligned with authentication sub-domain.

title_en: Define Critical Functions, MTD and RTO
definition_short_en: Critical business functions, Maximum Tolerable Downtime, and Recovery Time Objective must be defined to prioritize recovery activities and set business continuity targets.
classification_rationale: Required outcome defining critical functions and recovery objectives; business continuity governance requirement.

definition_short_en: Identify critical system components and functions by performing a criticality analysis to focus protection and resilience efforts on the most important assets.
classification_rationale: Control performing criticality analysis to identify critical components; asset inventory and prioritization sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission to guide risk-based allocation of protection efforts.
classification_rationale: Control prioritizing assets by classification, criticality and mission impact; asset inventory sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Employ mechanisms for coordinating audit information among external organizations when audit records are transmitted across organizational boundaries to maintain accountability and traceability.
classification_rationale: Control coordinating audit information across organizational boundaries; logging and monitoring sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Coordinate with external organizations for cross-organization management of identifiers to ensure unique and consistent identity references across federated organizational boundaries.
classification_rationale: Control coordinating identifier management across organizations; access review and federation sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Verify that certificates used to validate cryptographic authentication assertions are stored in a manner that protects them from unauthorized modification, preserving trust in authentication decisions.
classification_rationale: Preventive control protecting authentication certificates from modification; authentication sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Verify a documented policy for cryptographic key management and a key lifecycle exists, following a recognized key management standard such as NIST SP 800-57.
classification_rationale: Documented key management policy and lifecycle following a standard; data protection and encryption policy artifact.

definition_short_en: Implement authentication mechanisms to cryptographic modules that meet applicable laws, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidelines governing such authentication.
classification_rationale: Preventive technical control authenticating to cryptographic modules per regulatory requirements; data protection and encryption sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The application uses proven implementations of cryptographic primitives and does not implement custom cryptographic algorithms, avoiding weaknesses introduced by homegrown cryptography.
classification_rationale: Preventive control requiring proven cryptographic primitives instead of custom algorithms; application security governance sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for cryptography must include at least the requirements set out in the National Cryptographic Standards published by the NCA.
classification_rationale: Regulatory requirement mandating cryptography requirements meet the NCA National Cryptographic Standards; data protection and encryption domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for entity personnel must be identified, documented, and approved prior to, during, and upon the end or termination of their employment.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to define and approve personnel cybersecurity requirements across the employment lifecycle; personnel security sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements defined for the entity's personnel must be implemented across the employment lifecycle to enforce security obligations for staff.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement mandating implementation of personnel cybersecurity requirements; personnel security sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity considerations must be integrated into the entity's human resources practices, covering the personnel lifecycle from recruitment through termination to address people-related security risks.
classification_rationale: A governance requirement to embed cybersecurity into HR/personnel practices, mapping to People & Personnel Security.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity incident and threat management must, at minimum, define documented incident response plans and escalation procedures to ensure timely and structured handling of security events.
classification_rationale: Requirement mandating incident response plans and escalation procedures under Incident Management.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity department must identify and document cybersecurity policies and procedures, including controls and requirements, and obtain approval from the entity's Authorized Official.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to define, document, and approve cybersecurity policies and procedures under Policies, Standards & Exceptions.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity department must identify, document, and approve the entity's cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures to standardize how risks are assessed and treated.
classification_rationale: Requirement to establish and approve a risk management methodology, mapping to Risk Management despite the title's monitoring label.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity risk assessment procedures must be applied at least at the early stage of technology projects to identify and address risks before implementation.
classification_rationale: Requirement mandating risk assessment early in technology projects, mapping to Risk Management.

definition_short_en: All cybersecurity positions must be filled by full-time, qualified Saudi cybersecurity professionals to ensure adequate national capability and competence within the entity.
classification_rationale: Governance staffing requirement for the cybersecurity function, mapping to Strategy & Governance.

definition_short_en: The Authorized Official must identify, document, and approve the governance organizational structure, roles, and responsibilities for the entity's cybersecurity function.
classification_rationale: Requirement to define and approve cybersecurity governance structure, roles, and responsibilities under Strategy & Governance.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities must be reviewed and updated at planned intervals or upon changes to relevant legislative and regulatory requirements to keep them current.
classification_rationale: Requirement to periodically review and update cybersecurity roles under Strategy & Governance.

definition_short_en: The entity's cybersecurity strategy must be identified, documented, approved, and supported by the head of the entity or their delegate to ensure executive backing and direction.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to establish and endorse a cybersecurity strategy under Strategy & Governance.

title_en: Security in Project and Change Management
definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements must be embedded into the entity's project management methodology and into information and technology asset change management processes.
classification_rationale: Requirement to integrate cybersecurity into project and change management, mapping to Change & Release Management.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse the DNS application-layer protocol for command and control, blending malicious communications with legitimate traffic to evade detection and network filtering.
classification_rationale: An adversary technique (threat) describing DNS-based C2, mapping to Threat Detection & Alerts.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a data management process covering data sensitivity, ownership, handling, retention limits, and disposal requirements to govern data throughout its lifecycle.
classification_rationale: A data management process spanning classification, handling, retention, and disposal, mapping to Data Classification.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting the entity's data and information must be implemented according to each item's assigned classification level to ensure proportionate safeguards.
classification_rationale: Requirement to apply protection commensurate with data classification, mapping to Data Protection & Encryption.

definition_short_en: Implement boundary protection mechanisms to isolate system components that support mission-essential functions, limiting exposure and lateral movement across the environment.
classification_rationale: A technical preventive safeguard isolating critical components via network boundary protection under Network & Comms Security.

definition_short_en: Verify that all sensitive data created and processed by the application is identified and classified into defined protection levels to drive appropriate handling controls.
classification_rationale: A verifiable control ensuring application sensitive data is identified and classified, mapping to Data Classification.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting and handling the entity's data must be identified, documented, and approved in line with relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
classification_rationale: Regulatory-driven requirement to define and approve data protection and handling requirements under Data Classification.

definition_short_en: Classify data by sensitivity and define handling, retention, and disposal rules, providing the foundation for downstream controls such as encryption and data loss prevention.
classification_rationale: A policy statement establishing data classification and handling rules that underpin encryption and DLP, mapping to Data Classification.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may collect data from local system sources such as file systems, configuration files, local databases, virtual machine files, or process memory prior to exfiltration.
classification_rationale: An adversary data collection technique (threat) mapping to Threat Detection & Alerts.

title_en: Data Compression and Encryption for Exfiltration
definition_short_en: Adversaries may use utilities to compress and/or encrypt collected data before exfiltration, reducing volume and evading content inspection during transfer out of the network.
classification_rationale: An adversary technique (threat) describing pre-exfiltration data staging via compression/encryption, mapping to Threat Detection & Alerts.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse an existing legitimate external web service to exfiltrate data rather than using their primary command and control channel, blending with normal traffic.
classification_rationale: An adversary exfiltration technique (threat) using legitimate web services, mapping to Threat Detection & Alerts.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over a protocol different from the existing command and control channel to evade monitoring focused on the primary channel.
classification_rationale: An adversary exfiltration technique (threat) over an alternative protocol, mapping to Threat Detection & Alerts.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may stage collected data in a central location or directory prior to exfiltration, consolidating it to streamline transfer out of the compromised environment.
classification_rationale: An adversary data staging technique (threat) preceding exfiltration, mapping to Threat Detection & Alerts.

definition_short_en: Employ data mining protection mechanisms to detect and defend against unauthorized data mining of organizational data stores by internal or external actors.
classification_rationale: A technical detective safeguard against unauthorized data mining, mapping to Data Protection & Encryption.

definition_short_en: Specifies how long each type of organizational data must be retained and how it must be securely destroyed once it is no longer needed for business or legal purposes.
classification_rationale: A policy defining retention periods and secure disposal, mapping to Privacy, Retention & Disposal.

title_en: Secure Storage of Sensitive Mobile Data
definition_short_en: The application securely stores sensitive data using platform-provided mechanisms such as the operating system Keychain or Keystore rather than insecure custom storage.
classification_rationale: A technical preventive control mandating OS-provided secure storage (Keychain/Keystore) for sensitive data, mapping to Data Protection & Encryption.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting and handling entity data and information must be identified, documented, and approved in line with applicable legislative and regulatory obligations.
classification_rationale: A required outcome to define and approve data protection requirements per regulation; governance-level regulatory requirement in the data protection sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Enforce revocation of access authorizations that result from changes to the security attributes of subjects and objects, ensuring stale permissions are removed promptly.
classification_rationale: A technical safeguard enforcing revocation of authorizations upon attribute changes; authorization/least-privilege domain.

definition_short_en: Verify the application restricts access to specific data items so that only consumers holding explicit permissions for those items can access them.
classification_rationale: Technical authorization control restricting data-item access to explicitly permitted consumers; least-privilege/authorization domain.

definition_short_en: When users create or update passwords, verify that chosen passwords are not present on lists of commonly-used, expected, or compromised passwords before acceptance.
classification_rationale: Authenticator management control screening passwords against compromised lists; authentication/MFA sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Verify that security controls prevent browsers from rendering content or functionality contained in HTTP responses within an incorrect or unintended context.
classification_rationale: Application-layer technical control preventing browser mis-rendering of responses; app/API security testing sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Analyze proposed changes to the system to determine potential security and privacy impacts prior to implementing those changes.
classification_rationale: Organizational control requiring security impact analysis before change implementation; change and release management sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information transmitted across communication channels to prevent interception or tampering in transit.
classification_rationale: Technical control protecting data in transit confidentiality and integrity; network and communications security sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a documented baseline configuration for the system to provide a known, secure reference state for hardening and change control.
classification_rationale: A configuration baseline artifact for the system; configuration and hardening sub-domain at technical abstraction.

definition_short_en: Provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known good state following a disruption, compromise, or failure event.
classification_rationale: Recovery-function control restoring the system to a known state after disruption; disaster recovery and resilience sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Account data storage is minimized through defined retention and disposal policies, procedures, and processes that limit how long stored data is kept.
classification_rationale: Organizational control minimizing stored data via retention and disposal; privacy, retention and disposal sub-domain.

title_en: Sensitive Data Encryption And Key Management
definition_short_en: Apply encryption to sensitive data and securely manage the associated encryption keys throughout their lifecycle to protect data confidentiality.
classification_rationale: Technical control encrypting sensitive data and managing keys; data protection and encryption sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Verify the application restricts function-level access so that only consumers holding explicit permissions can invoke the corresponding functionality.
classification_rationale: Technical authorization control restricting function-level access to permitted consumers; least-privilege/authorization sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with the applicable access control policies.
classification_rationale: Technical control enforcing approved logical access authorizations per access control policy; authorization sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected across storage systems as a required security outcome for the entity.
classification_rationale: A required protection outcome for data-at-rest CIA; governance-level internal requirement in data protection sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Check the validity of information inputs to the system to ensure they conform to expected format, type, and range before processing.
classification_rationale: Application-layer technical control validating information inputs; app and API security testing sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Implement boundary protection mechanisms to isolate system components from one another, limiting lateral movement and containing potential compromises.
classification_rationale: Technical boundary-protection control isolating system components; network and communications security sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Verify the application uses memory-safe string handling, safer memory copy, and pointer arithmetic to detect or prevent stack, buffer, or heap overflows.
classification_rationale: Technical secure-coding control using memory-safe operations to prevent overflows; code and components sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information, enabling integrity monitoring across system artifacts.
classification_rationale: Detective technical control using cryptography to detect unauthorized software/firmware/information changes; logging and monitoring sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Include defined security requirements, descriptions, and criteria in acquisition contracts for the system, its components, or system services.
classification_rationale: Organizational control embedding security criteria into acquisition contracts; third-party and supply risk sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected as part of the entity's resilience objectives for stored information.
classification_rationale: A required protection outcome for data-at-rest CIA framed under resilience; governance-level internal requirement in data protection sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Enforce information flow control using security and privacy policy filters as the basis for deciding whether information may move between system domains.
classification_rationale: Technical control enforcing information flow via policy filters; network and communications security sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information across infrastructure communication paths to guard against interception and tampering.
classification_rationale: Technical control protecting data-in-transit confidentiality and integrity; network and communications security sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Strong cryptography and secure protocols are implemented to safeguard cardholder PAN during transmission over open, public networks.
classification_rationale: Technical control applying strong cryptography to protect PAN in transit over public networks; data protection and encryption sub-domain.

definition_short_en: An access control system restricts access to system components and the cardholder data environment based on need to know and defaults to deny all.
classification_rationale: Technical least-privilege control enforcing need-to-know with default deny-all; authorization and least-privilege sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service attacks on the system to preserve availability of services and resources.
classification_rationale: Technical control mitigating denial-of-service attack effects to preserve availability; network and communications security sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The organization must formally establish a dedicated cybersecurity department or function within the entity to own and drive information security governance and operations.
classification_rationale: Mandatory governance outcome requiring a formal security organizational unit; maps to strategy and governance requirement.

definition_short_en: Outcomes, capabilities, and services the organization depends upon are identified, understood, and communicated to support informed governance and resilience decisions.
classification_rationale: Governance objective to understand and communicate business dependencies; aligns with strategy and governance context-setting.

definition_short_en: Require the developer of the system, component, or service to provide design and implementation information describing how security controls are built and enforced.
classification_rationale: Organizational safeguard requiring developer assurance artifacts within the SDLC; documentation-verified preventive control.

definition_short_en: Employ fire detection systems that activate automatically and notify personnel and responders in the event of a fire affecting facilities housing systems.
classification_rationale: Physical detective safeguard protecting facilities; automatic fire detection maps to physical and environmental security.

definition_short_en: Mobile devices must require strong authentication, such as passcodes or biometrics, before granting access to enterprise resources and data.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive authentication control on mobile endpoints; maps to authentication and MFA sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may purchase or steal SSL/TLS certificates during resource development to lend legitimacy to infrastructure used for targeting and interception.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique (threat) abusing digital certificates for network communications trust; risk-level artifact.

title_en: Direct Network Flood Denial of Service
definition_short_en: Adversaries may cause denial of service by directly sending high-volume network traffic to a target, overwhelming its bandwidth or processing capacity.
classification_rationale: Volumetric DoS adversary technique classified as a network threat artifact at risk abstraction.

definition_short_en: Disable wireless networking capabilities embedded within system components prior to issuance and deployment when they are not intended for operational use.
classification_rationale: Technical hardening control reducing attack surface by disabling unused radios; maps to configuration and hardening.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may disable or modify system firewalls to bypass controls that limit network usage and enable unauthorized inbound or outbound communications.
classification_rationale: Defense-evasion adversary technique tampering with firewall controls; network threat artifact.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may disable Windows event logging to limit the telemetry available for detection, alerting, and audit, hindering defender visibility.
classification_rationale: Defense-evasion technique impairing logging; threat artifact tied to logging and monitoring visibility.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may disable or tamper with security tools such as antivirus and EDR to avoid detection of their tools and malicious activities.
classification_rationale: Defense-evasion adversary technique disabling defensive tooling; threat under detection and alerts.

definition_short_en: A disaster recovery test is conducted at least annually to validate recovery time and recovery point objectives and confirm restoration capabilities.
classification_rationale: Recovery safeguard validating DR objectives through periodic testing; maps to disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may interact with the Windows Registry to gather information about the system, its configuration, and installed software to inform further actions.
classification_rationale: Discovery adversary technique enumerating system configuration; threat artifact under threat detection.

definition_short_en: An adversary may attempt to enumerate running virtual machines after gaining access to a host or hypervisor to map the virtual environment.
classification_rationale: Discovery technique enumerating VMs on a hypervisor; threat artifact within cloud and virtual platform.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may attempt to find local system groups and permission settings to identify accounts and privileges available for escalation or lateral movement.
classification_rationale: Discovery technique enumerating local groups and permissions; threat artifact under threat detection.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate the security software, configurations, defensive tools, and sensors installed on a system to plan evasion.
classification_rationale: Discovery technique fingerprinting defensive tooling to enable evasion; threat artifact under threat detection.

definition_short_en: Obtain system documentation, protect it as controlled information, and make it available only to authorized personnel who require it for their duties.
classification_rationale: Organizational preventive control governing acquisition and controlled distribution of system documentation; SDLC governance.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may attempt to find domain-level groups and permission settings to understand directory structure and identify privileged targets.
classification_rationale: Discovery technique enumerating domain groups and permissions; threat artifact under threat detection.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse CDN and multi-domain hosting routing schemes to obfuscate the true destination of HTTPS command-and-control traffic.
classification_rationale: Command-and-control obfuscation technique abusing CDN routing; network threat artifact at risk abstraction.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may use domain generation algorithms to dynamically compute destinations for command-and-control traffic, evading static blocklists and takedowns.
classification_rationale: Command-and-control technique using DGA to evade detection; threat artifact under threat detection and alerts.

definition_short_en: Disable accounts within a defined period when they expire, are no longer associated with a user, or have been inactive beyond a defined threshold.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive control disabling stale accounts to reduce identity attack surface; identity lifecycle management.

definition_short_en: Dynamically associate security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects to enforce access and handling decisions as context and data change.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive control binding security attributes to subjects and objects for authorization; least-privilege enforcement.

definition_short_en: Dynamically relocate sensors or monitoring capabilities under defined conditions to improve coverage, resilience, and evasion resistance of detection.
classification_rationale: Technical detective control repositioning monitoring sensors adaptively; maps to logging and monitoring.

definition_short_en: Protect workstations and servers from viruses, suspicious programs, and malware using modern, advanced endpoint protection technologies such as antivirus and EDR.
classification_rationale: Technical detective control providing antimalware and EDR on endpoints; maps to systems, servers, and endpoint.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may spoof a sender's identity by modifying relevant email headers to establish contact with victims under false pretenses.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique forging email headers for social engineering; threat artifact under email and digital comms.

definition_short_en: Analyze and filter inbound email using advanced protection mechanisms to detect and block phishing and spam messages before they reach recipients.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard filtering email content for phishing/spam maps to Email/Web security; preventive automated control.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting the entity's email service must be formally identified, documented, and approved by the appropriate authority.
classification_rationale: Governance requirement to identify, document, and approve email security requirements; outcome-oriented, not a specific mechanism.

definition_short_en: Adversaries abuse the Event Monitor Daemon (emond) to establish persistence by scheduling malicious commands that execute on predictable system event triggers.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary persistence technique on endpoints/systems, a threat rather than a safeguard.

definition_short_en: Verify that untrusted input is decoded or unescaped into a canonical form only once, and only when encoded data in that form is expected.
classification_rationale: Application-security verification safeguard for input canonicalization; preventive technical control tested during app security review.

definition_short_en: Apply encryption to sensitive data and securely generate, store, rotate, and manage the associated cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle.
classification_rationale: Technical data-protection safeguard covering encryption and key management; maps to Data Protection & Encryption.

title_en: Strong Cryptography for PAN in Messaging
definition_short_en: Primary account numbers must be secured with strong cryptography whenever transmitted over end-user messaging channels such as email, instant messaging, SMS, or chat.
classification_rationale: Safeguard mandating strong cryptography for cardholder data in transit over messaging; data protection focus.

definition_short_en: Maintain an accurate and current inventory of all hardware assets managed by the organization to support asset accountability and security controls.
classification_rationale: Organizational control maintaining a hardware inventory; detective visibility of managed assets under Asset Inventory.

definition_short_en: Maintain a comprehensive inventory of assets including endpoints, servers, software, and cloud resources, each recorded with an assigned owner and classification.
classification_rationale: Organizational asset inventory control spanning asset types with owner and classification attributes; core Asset Inventory.

definition_short_en: Maintain a current inventory of software, services, and systems managed by the organization to track authorized components and detect unauthorized ones.
classification_rationale: Organizational control maintaining a software/services inventory; maps to Software & License management.

definition_short_en: Assess and record risks in a register with treatment plans, periodic reviews, and documented decisions to accept or transfer residual risk.
classification_rationale: Ongoing risk-management process: assess, register, treat, and review risks with accept/transfer decisions; Risk Management domain.

definition_short_en: Provide emergency lighting throughout facility areas that support essential mission and business functions to sustain operations during power loss.
classification_rationale: Physical environmental safeguard providing emergency lighting for continuity; recovery control in Physical & Environmental.

definition_short_en: Adversaries craft adversarial example inputs designed to evade detection or manipulate the classification decisions of a machine learning model.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversarial ML evasion technique against model integrity; a threat affecting application/model security.

definition_short_en: Analyze potentially adverse security events to better understand the associated activities and identify whether they constitute an incident.
classification_rationale: Detective control analyzing adverse events to detect incidents; maps to Threat Detection & Alerts.

definition_short_en: Require providers of external system services to identify the functions, ports, protocols, and other services required to use those external services.
classification_rationale: Third-party control requiring external providers to disclose required functions/ports/protocols; supply-risk governance.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may delete files left behind by their intrusion activity to remove evidence and hinder detection or forensic investigation.
classification_rationale: Adversary anti-forensic file deletion technique aimed at defeating investigation; a threat under Forensics & Investigation.

definition_short_en: Verify that the application only accepts files of a size it can process without causing loss of performance or a denial-of-service condition.
classification_rationale: Application safeguard enforcing file size limits to prevent denial of service; preventive technical control.

definition_short_en: Verify that files uploaded or generated from untrusted input and stored in public folders are not executed as server-side code when accessed directly.
classification_rationale: Application safeguard preventing server-side execution of untrusted uploaded files; preventive control against RCE.

definition_short_en: Ensure mounting of unneeded filesystem types is disabled on systems to reduce the local attack surface available to adversaries.
classification_rationale: System hardening safeguard disabling unnecessary filesystems to reduce attack surface; Configuration & Hardening.

definition_short_en: Configuration standards for network security controls, such as firewalls, are defined and implemented to enforce consistent secure baselines.
classification_rationale: Defines configuration standards for network security controls; a standard/baseline artifact under Network security.

definition_short_en: Implement an explicit default-deny rule at the end of the access control list to block all traffic not explicitly permitted.
classification_rationale: Preventive network safeguard enforcing implicit deny on firewall ACLs; core network access control.

definition_short_en: Enable stateful inspection on all firewall interfaces and log all dropped packets to a centralized SIEM to support threat hunting.
classification_rationale: Firewall safeguard enabling stateful inspection and centralized drop logging for detection; network security control.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be supported by technical security standards, such as firewall rule standards, to ensure enforceable implementation.
classification_rationale: Policy statement requiring technical standards to underpin cybersecurity policies; Policies, Standards & Exceptions.

title_en: Simulated Phishing and Physical Security Testing
definition_short_en: Test human defenses and awareness through simulated phishing campaigns and physical security assessments to gauge susceptibility to social engineering.
classification_rationale: Security assessment exercising human defenses via simulated phishing and physical tests; Security Testing & Assessments.

definition_short_en: Deploy a web application firewall to inspect and filter HTTP traffic, protecting web applications from common exploitation attempts.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard deploying a WAF to protect web applications; preventive control in App & API security.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may gather credentials by forcing a user to automatically provide authentication information through a mechanism that lets them intercept it.
classification_rationale: Adversary forced-authentication technique to intercept credential material; a threat relevant to Authentication.

definition_short_en: Restrict identity, credential, and access management to products and services that have been formally approved by the General Services Administration for organizational use.
classification_rationale: A regulatory-driven required outcome mandating approved IAM products, so ART-REQ in the identity domain.

definition_short_en: Ensure only the latest recommended Transport Layer Security protocol versions, such as TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3, are enabled while deprecated versions remain disabled.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard enforcing modern encryption in transit, mapped to data protection and encryption.

definition_short_en: Ensure every HTTP response containing a message body includes a Content-Type header that accurately matches the actual content, preventing content sniffing and misinterpretation.
classification_rationale: Application-level technical safeguard on HTTP responses, verifiable via testing, so ART-CTR under app/API security.

definition_short_en: Ensure legal and regulatory requirements involving artificial intelligence are understood, actively managed, and documented across the organization's governance activities.
classification_rationale: Governance outcome for legal/regulatory understanding of AI, mapped to compliance and assurance.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may modify Group Policy Objects within a domain to subvert intended discretionary access controls and gain unauthorized privileges or persistence.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique against domain access controls, so a threat under privileged access.

definition_short_en: Automatically disable temporary and emergency accounts after a defined time period elapses, limiting the window during which such accounts can be abused.
classification_rationale: Automated account lifecycle safeguard disabling temporary accounts, so ART-CTR under identity lifecycle.

definition_short_en: Ensure Transport Layer Security is used for all connectivity between clients and external-facing HTTP-based services to protect data transmitted over untrusted networks.
classification_rationale: Technical encryption-in-transit safeguard for external services, mapped to data protection and encryption.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may use hidden windows to conceal malicious application activity from plain sight of users while executing operations on a compromised system.
classification_rationale: Adversary defense-evasion technique on endpoints, so a threat under systems and endpoint security.

definition_short_en: Ensure a high-level design of the system is developed and documented to guide secure architecture, implementation, and subsequent review activities.
classification_rationale: Required SDLC outcome to produce documented design, so ART-REQ under AppSec governance and SDLC.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may gather a victim's IP addresses during reconnaissance to support later targeting, scanning, and attack planning against exposed infrastructure.
classification_rationale: Reconnaissance technique gathering network addresses, so a threat under network and communications security.

title_en: Developer Identification of Ports and Protocols
definition_short_en: Require the developer of the system, component, or service to identify the functions, ports, protocols, and services intended for organizational use.
classification_rationale: Required developer obligation to document ports/protocols, so ART-REQ under AppSec governance and SDLC.

definition_short_en: Ensure identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization throughout their lifecycle in a controlled manner.
classification_rationale: High-level outcome requiring managed identities and credentials, so ART-REQ under identity lifecycle.

definition_short_en: Define, manage, enforce, and review access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations in policy, incorporating least privilege and separation of duties principles.
classification_rationale: Policy statement governing authorizations with least privilege and separation of duties, so ART-POL under authorization.

definition_short_en: Ensure identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context and risk of the interactions to establish appropriate assurance levels.
classification_rationale: Required outcome for context-based identity proofing and credential binding, so ART-REQ under identity lifecycle.

definition_short_en: Ensure identity assertions are protected, securely conveyed, and verified to prevent tampering, replay, or spoofing during authentication exchanges.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard protecting authentication assertions, so ART-CTR under authentication.

definition_short_en: Manage account lifecycle by provisioning on joining, adjusting entitlements on moving, immediately deprovisioning on leaving, and controlling service-account management.
classification_rationale: Multi-stage lifecycle process across joiner/mover/leaver, so ART-PRC under identity lifecycle; bundles several stages.

definition_short_en: Protect backups from alteration or deletion, isolate them from production, and periodically test restoration to guarantee reliable recovery from ransomware.
classification_rationale: Recovery safeguard protecting and testing backups against ransomware, so ART-CTR under disaster recovery and resilience.

definition_short_en: Determine the impact and magnitude of a security incident to inform prioritization, response decisions, escalation, and appropriate recovery efforts.
classification_rationale: Procedural step assessing incident impact during response, so ART-PRO under incident management.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may insert, delete, or manipulate data to influence external outcomes or hide activity, thereby threatening the integrity of organizational data.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique attacking data integrity, so a threat under data protection.

definition_short_en: Require that the registration process for granting a logical access account includes explicit supervisor or sponsor authorization before the account is issued.
classification_rationale: Organizational safeguard requiring sponsor authorization for account registration, so ART-CTR under identity lifecycle.

title_en: Full Memory Encryption for Data In Use
definition_short_en: Ensure full memory encryption is in use to protect sensitive data while it is being actively processed in system memory.
classification_rationale: Technical encryption safeguard for data in use, so ART-CTR under data protection and encryption.

definition_short_en: Monitor inbound and outbound communications traffic to detect unusual or unauthorized activities and conditions indicating potential compromise or exfiltration.
classification_rationale: Detective monitoring safeguard on network traffic, so ART-CTR under logging and monitoring.

definition_short_en: Designate one key person and at least one backup responsible for managing the enterprise's incident handling process to ensure clear ownership.
classification_rationale: Organizational safeguard assigning incident handling ownership, so ART-CTR under incident management.

title_en: Triage and Validation of Incident Reports
definition_short_en: Ensure incident reports are triaged and validated to confirm legitimacy, prioritize response, and filter out false positives before escalation.
classification_rationale: Procedural step to triage and validate incident reports, so ART-PRO under incident management.

definition_short_en: Establish an incident response policy that defines the organization's approach to detecting, reporting, and responding to security incidents and breaches.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement establishing incident response, so ART-POL under incident management.

definition_short_en: Once a security incident is formally declared, the organization executes its predefined incident response plan to coordinate containment, investigation, and remediation activities.
classification_rationale: Describes running the incident response process upon declaration, a step-by-step operational activity in incident management.

definition_short_en: Relevant incident information is shared with designated internal teams and external parties to support coordinated response, awareness, and regulatory obligations during a security event.
classification_rationale: Communication activity sharing incident details with stakeholders maps to crisis communications within incident response.

definition_short_en: A formal incident response plan is developed and approved by management to enable rapid, structured, and effective handling of cybersecurity incidents across the organization.
classification_rationale: A documented, approved incident response plan is a plan artifact governing incident management.

definition_short_en: Security incidents are escalated or elevated to higher severity tiers or authority levels as circumstances warrant, ensuring appropriate resources and decision-makers engage promptly.
classification_rationale: Escalation as needed is a conditional operational step within incident management.

definition_short_en: Internal teams and external parties are notified when security incidents occur, ensuring timely awareness and enabling coordinated response and compliance with reporting obligations.
classification_rationale: Notifying stakeholders of incidents is a crisis communication activity in incident response.

definition_short_en: Personnel with incident response duties receive training to build the skills and readiness needed to detect, report, and handle cybersecurity incidents effectively.
classification_rationale: Providing incident response training is an awareness/training program activity for personnel.

definition_short_en: The recovery phase of the incident response plan is executed once triggered by the response process, restoring affected systems and services to normal secure operation.
classification_rationale: Executing the recovery portion of the plan is a recovery-oriented operational process.

definition_short_en: Requirements for cybersecurity incident and threat management must be identified, documented, and formally approved to establish a governed foundation for organizational response capabilities.
classification_rationale: Identifying, documenting, and approving requirements is a governance requirement outcome for incident and threat management.

definition_short_en: Requirements addressing cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into supplier and third-party contracts to enforce security obligations.
classification_rationale: Requirement integrated into contracts to address supply-chain cyber risk maps to third-party risk with contractual requirement type.

definition_short_en: Personnel involved in incident handling are provided with incident response training to ensure they can respond competently and consistently to security events.
classification_rationale: Incident response training is an awareness/training program activity, duplicate concept to 0380.

definition_short_en: An incident response plan and supporting procedures are developed and approved to enable rapid and effective handling of cybersecurity incidents across the organization.
classification_rationale: Developing and approving an incident response plan and procedures is a plan artifact in incident management.

definition_short_en: Public updates about incident recovery progress are shared using approved communication channels and vetted messaging to maintain transparency and protect organizational reputation.
classification_rationale: Sharing public recovery updates via approved messaging is a crisis communications activity.

definition_short_en: Detected security incidents are contained to limit their scope, prevent lateral spread, and reduce impact on systems, data, and services during the response process.
classification_rationale: Containing incidents is a corrective operational step within the incident management process.

definition_short_en: An adversary may attempt to block indicators or events normally captured by security sensors, preventing collection and analysis to evade detection of malicious activity.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary evasion technique against detection sensors, a threat artifact in threat detection.

definition_short_en: After a malicious tool is detected and quarantined, an adversary may strip its indicators and deploy an updated variant that evades existing detection signatures.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique to evade tool-based detection, a threat artifact.

definition_short_en: Procedures are implemented governing the use of maintenance personnel who lack appropriate security clearances, ensuring supervision and safeguards during their access to systems.
classification_rationale: Procedures for handling uncleared maintenance personnel is a personnel security process.

definition_short_en: Individuals accessing systems that process, store, or transmit classified information are verified as cleared and indoctrinated to the highest classification level involved.
classification_rationale: Verifying personnel clearance before classified system access is a preventive organizational personnel-security control.

definition_short_en: The system enforces approved authorizations controlling how information flows within it and between interconnected systems, preventing unauthorized data movement across boundaries.
classification_rationale: Enforcing authorized information flow within/between systems is a preventive technical network control.

definition_short_en: An overarching information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated to all relevant personnel to direct the organization's security posture and expectations.
classification_rationale: An established, published, maintained information security policy is a governing policy statement.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting the entity's information systems and processing facilities must be identified, documented, and formally approved to establish governed protection expectations.
classification_rationale: Identifying, documenting, and approving protection requirements for information systems is a governance requirement outcome.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting the entity's information systems and processing facilities must be implemented, operationalizing the documented safeguards into effective technical and organizational measures.
classification_rationale: Mandating implementation of information system protection requirements is a governance requirement outcome.

definition_short_en: Output encoding for HTTP responses, HTML, or XML documents is verified as appropriate for the target context, preventing injection and cross-site scripting vulnerabilities.
classification_rationale: Context-appropriate output encoding to prevent injection is a preventive technical application-security control.

definition_short_en: Data selection and database queries use parameterized queries to separate code from data, protecting applications against SQL and other injection attacks.
classification_rationale: Requiring parameterized queries to prevent injection is a preventive technical application-security control.

definition_short_en: A vulnerability arising when large language model output is accepted without validation, enabling cross-site scripting, server-side request forgery, or privilege escalation in downstream systems.
classification_rationale: Describes a weakness from unvalidated LLM output leading to exploitation, a vulnerability artifact in application security.

definition_short_en: An incident handling capability for insider threats is coordinated across relevant organizational entities to ensure unified detection, investigation, and response to malicious or negligent insiders.
classification_rationale: Coordinating cross-organizational insider threat incident handling is a personnel/insider security process.

definition_short_en: Require developers of a system, component, or service to employ interactive application security testing (IAST) tools during runtime to identify and remediate software flaws and vulnerabilities.
classification_rationale: Runtime app security testing tooling to detect code flaws maps to application security testing (SD-05.02); technical detective control.

definition_short_en: Describes an adversary technique of defacing systems internal to an organization in an attempt to intimidate, mislead, or disrupt internal users and undermine trust.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique description, not a safeguard; modeled as a threat/IoC under threat intel (SD-06.05).

definition_short_en: Establish, maintain, and regularly update an inventory of all systems, applications, and projects that collect, process, store, or transmit personally identifiable information.
classification_rationale: Required outcome to inventory PII-processing systems; privacy obligation maps to privacy/retention (SD-02.05).

definition_short_en: Provide a trusted communications path between the user and the system that is irrefutably distinguishable from other communication paths to prevent spoofing and interception.
classification_rationale: Trusted path safeguard for secure communications; technical preventive control under network/comms security (SD-04.01).

definition_short_en: The mobile application detects whether it is running on a rooted or jailbroken device and responds appropriately to protect data and enforce integrity controls.
classification_rationale: Application-level detection of compromised device state; technical detective control within app security (SD-05.01).

definition_short_en: Employ a joint authorization process for the system that requires multiple authorizing officials from the same organization to approve system operation and accountability decisions.
classification_rationale: Organizational governance safeguard requiring multiple authorizing officials; maps to strategy and governance (SD-01.01).

definition_short_en: Describes an adversary technique of modifying the operating system kernel or loading malicious kernel modules to automatically execute programs on system boot for persistence.
classification_rationale: Adversary persistence technique, not a safeguard; modeled as a threat under threat intel (SD-06.05).

definition_short_en: Deploy Windows Local Administrator Password Solution to automatically manage, rotate, and randomize unique local administrator passwords across domain-joined endpoints to limit lateral movement.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard managing privileged local admin credentials; maps to privileged access management (SD-03.04).

definition_short_en: Describes an adversary technique of establishing persistence by adding Lc_load_dylib entries so malicious content executes when tainted binaries are run on the system.
classification_rationale: Adversary persistence technique via binary tainting, not a safeguard; modeled as a threat (SD-06.05).

definition_short_en: Defines rules for granting access to corporate systems and data on a least-privilege basis, including periodic access reviews and prompt revocation of access upon termination.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement defining least-privilege access rules; maps to authorization and least privilege (SD-03.03).

definition_short_en: Configure data access control lists based on each user's need to know and apply the least-privilege principle to limit access to only what is required.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard configuring ACLs on need-to-know least-privilege basis; maps to authorization and least privilege (SD-03.03).

title_en: Least Privilege for Users and Processes
definition_short_en: Employ the principle of least privilege, permitting only authorized accesses for users and processes acting on their behalf that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.
classification_rationale: Safeguard enforcing least privilege for users and processes; maps to authorization and least privilege (SD-03.03).

definition_short_en: Apply the security design principle of least privilege so that entities are granted the minimum access and capabilities necessary to perform their functions.
classification_rationale: Broad security design principle statement of least privilege; principle maps to authorization and least privilege (SD-03.03).

definition_short_en: Require developers to structure security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to facilitate controlling access with least privilege during system design and implementation.
classification_rationale: Developer requirement to architect components for least-privilege access control; secure design maps to AppSec governance/SDLC (SD-05.01).

definition_short_en: Legal, regulatory, and contractual cybersecurity requirements, including privacy and civil liberties obligations, are understood, documented, and managed across the organization.
classification_rationale: Required outcome that legal/regulatory obligations are understood and managed; maps to compliance and assurance (SD-01.04).

definition_short_en: Limit the personally identifiable information contained in audit records to only the elements identified as necessary in the privacy risk assessment to reduce exposure.
classification_rationale: Safeguard minimizing PII in audit logs per privacy assessment; data minimization maps to privacy/retention (SD-02.05).

definition_short_en: Collect audit logs and ensure that logging has been enabled across all enterprise assets in accordance with the enterprise audit log management process.
classification_rationale: Operational safeguard enabling and collecting logs across assets; maps to logging and monitoring (SD-06.01).

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain an audit log management process that defines the enterprise's logging requirements, including collection, retention, and review of security-relevant events.
classification_rationale: Defines a repeatable audit log management process and logging requirements; maps to logging and monitoring (SD-06.01).

definition_short_en: Audit logs are reviewed for anomalies or suspicious activity using automated mechanisms to detect potential security incidents in a timely manner.
classification_rationale: Automated detective safeguard analyzing logs for suspicious activity; maps to threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Design system components with coordinated behavior so that combined resources and functions implement defined security capabilities more effectively than isolated components.
classification_rationale: Secure design safeguard for coordinated component behavior implementing capabilities; maps to AppSec governance/SDLC (SD-05.01).

definition_short_en: Prevent installation of system components unless verified as digitally signed with a certificate that is recognized and approved by the organization.
classification_rationale: Safeguard enforcing digital signature verification before component install; supply chain integrity maps to code/components/supply chain (SD-05.03).

definition_short_en: Restrict or prohibit field maintenance on system components, limiting such maintenance activities to defined authorized personnel or roles to protect system integrity.
classification_rationale: Organizational safeguard limiting field maintenance to authorized roles; system maintenance maps to systems/servers/endpoint (SD-04.02).

definition_short_en: Analyze malicious code and other residual artifacts remaining in the system after a security incident to understand impact, scope, and adversary behavior.
classification_rationale: Post-incident forensic analysis of malicious code and artifacts; maps to forensics and investigation (SD-07.02).

definition_short_en: Describes an adversary technique of deploying a malicious container into an environment to facilitate execution of code or evade existing defenses.
classification_rationale: Adversary container deployment technique, not a safeguard; modeled as a threat under threat intel (SD-06.05).

definition_short_en: Describes an adversary technique of developing malware and malware components that can be leveraged during targeting and offensive operations against victims.
classification_rationale: Adversary malware development technique, not a safeguard; modeled as a threat under threat intel (SD-06.05).

definition_short_en: Safeguard system preproduction and pre-release environments in proportion to risk across every phase of the software and system development life cycle to prevent compromise.
classification_rationale: Safeguard mechanism for preproduction environments within the SDLC, a change/release management concern.

definition_short_en: Install, enable, and enforce a Mandatory Access Control framework such as SELinux or AppArmor on systems to confine processes and enforce security policies.
classification_rationale: Technical hardening control enforcing MAC on operating systems; configuration/hardening domain.

definition_short_en: Understand the intended purposes, potentially beneficial uses, and context-specific laws applicable to an AI system to inform its trustworthy design and governance.
classification_rationale: Governance objective about understanding AI system purpose and legal context; strategy and governance.

definition_short_en: Employ the same mechanisms used in live operations within contingency training environments to give personnel more thorough and realistic preparation for recovery scenarios.
classification_rationale: Control improving contingency/continuity training realism; business continuity domain.

definition_short_en: Identify and apply appropriate methods and metrics to evaluate the trustworthiness of an AI system throughout its lifecycle, supporting objective measurement.
classification_rationale: Defines metrics/measures for evaluating AI trustworthiness; program management and metrics.

definition_short_en: Ensure the organizational mission is understood and used to inform and prioritize cybersecurity risk management decisions across the enterprise governance program.
classification_rationale: Governance objective aligning mission understanding with risk management; strategy and governance.

definition_short_en: Employ centralized mobile device management technologies to control, configure, and enforce security policies on mobile devices used to access organizational resources.
classification_rationale: Technical control deploying MDM to manage mobile endpoints; systems and endpoint domain.

definition_short_en: Separate and encrypt the entity's data and information stored on mobile devices and BYOD equipment to protect confidentiality if devices are lost or compromised.
classification_rationale: Data protection control encrypting and segregating data on mobile/BYOD devices; encryption domain.

definition_short_en: Identify, document, and approve cybersecurity requirements for mobile devices and BYOD security before they connect to the entity's network to control associated risk.
classification_rationale: Requirement to define, document, and approve mobile/BYOD cybersecurity requirements; governance outcome.

definition_short_en: Attackers trigger resource-heavy operations on large language models, causing service degradation, unavailability, or excessive operating costs for the hosting organization.
classification_rationale: Describes an LLM denial-of-service threat, not a safeguard; risk abstraction in application/AI context.

definition_short_en: Adversaries exploit access to a machine learning model to infer sensitive features or reconstruct instances of its training data, undermining data privacy.
classification_rationale: Describes model inversion threat against training data privacy; risk abstraction, not a control.

definition_short_en: Employ automated mechanisms to monitor and control remote access methods, detecting anomalous sessions and enforcing policy on connections into organizational systems.
classification_rationale: Automated detective control monitoring and controlling remote access; logging and monitoring domain.

definition_short_en: Monitor open-source information and public information sites to detect inadvertent or malicious disclosure of organizational information that could aid attackers.
classification_rationale: Detective control monitoring public sources for leaked organizational data; threat intel domain.

definition_short_en: Develop a system-level continuous monitoring strategy and implement continuous monitoring to maintain ongoing awareness of security posture and control effectiveness.
classification_rationale: Control establishing and implementing a continuous monitoring strategy; logging and monitoring domain.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse mshta.exe to proxy execution of malicious .hta files containing JavaScript or VBScript, bypassing application controls and defenses.
classification_rationale: Describes an mshta proxy-execution attack technique; threat abstraction relevant to threat detection.

definition_short_en: Implement multi-factor authentication for all access into the cardholder data environment to strengthen identity assurance and reduce unauthorized entry.
classification_rationale: MFA safeguard for all CDE access; authentication and MFA domain.

definition_short_en: Require multi-factor authentication for all external or remote access to the enterprise network, such as VPN connections, to prevent credential-based compromise.
classification_rationale: MFA safeguard for remote/VPN network access; authentication and MFA domain.

definition_short_en: Implement multi-factor authentication for access to non-privileged user accounts to raise identity assurance and mitigate credential theft across the user base.
classification_rationale: MFA safeguard for non-privileged accounts; authentication and MFA domain.

definition_short_en: Verify that out-of-band authentication requests, codes, or tokens are cryptographically bound to the original authentication request for which they were generated.
classification_rationale: Control ensuring out-of-band auth tokens bind to original request; authentication and MFA domain.

definition_short_en: Define minimum cybersecurity requirements for identity and access management authentication, at least single-factor username and password, for entity access controls.
classification_rationale: Requirement stating minimum authentication baseline for identity and access management; governance requirement.

definition_short_en: Verify that either a multi-factor authentication mechanism or a combination of single-factor mechanisms is required to access the application, strengthening identity assurance.
classification_rationale: Control requiring multi-factor or combined authentication for application access; authentication and MFA domain.

definition_short_en: Require multi-factor authentication for all administrative access to enterprise assets to protect high-privilege accounts against credential compromise and takeover.
classification_rationale: MFA safeguard specifically for administrative/privileged access; privileged access domain.

definition_short_en: Verify that system-generated initial passwords or activation codes are securely randomly generated, comply with password policy, and expire after a short period.
classification_rationale: Control on secure random generation and expiry of initial passwords/activation codes; authentication domain.

definition_short_en: Verify that lookup secrets, out-of-band codes, and time-based one-time passwords are only successfully usable once, preventing replay of authentication factors.
classification_rationale: Control enforcing single-use of OTPs, lookup secrets, and OOB codes; authentication and MFA domain.

definition_short_en: Implement multi-factor authentication for access to privileged accounts to protect elevated permissions against credential theft and unauthorized privileged use.
classification_rationale: MFA safeguard for privileged accounts; privileged access domain.

definition_short_en: Adversaries attempt to bypass multi-factor authentication by repeatedly generating MFA prompts sent to users, hoping fatigue leads them to approve fraudulent authentication requests and grant account access.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique (MFA fatigue/bombing) targeting authentication, so classified as a threat under Authentication&MFA.

definition_short_en: Require more than one independent authentication factor to reduce account-takeover risk, prioritizing administrative and remote access accounts before broader rollout across the organization.
classification_rationale: A specific preventive safeguard requiring multiple authentication factors; maps to Authentication&MFA sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Configure network security options to deny all outgoing NTLM authentication traffic to remote servers, hardening endpoints against credential relay and legacy protocol abuse.
classification_rationale: A concrete configuration baseline setting (deny outgoing NTLM); maps to Configuration&Hardening.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may disable network device firewall mechanisms entirely or add, delete, or modify specific rules to bypass controls that limit network access and usage.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique modifying firewall rules to defeat network controls; a threat under Network&Comms Security.

definition_short_en: Ensure network infrastructure devices and firmware are maintained up-to-date with current patches and supported software versions to remediate known vulnerabilities.
classification_rationale: A required outcome to keep infrastructure patched; maps to Vulnerability&Patch Mgmt as a requirement.

definition_short_en: Networks and network services are continuously monitored to detect potentially adverse events, anomalies, and indicators of compromise across the environment.
classification_rationale: Detective control monitoring networks for adverse events; maps to Logging&Monitoring.

definition_short_en: Logically or physically isolate and segment network segments using firewalls and defense-in-depth principles to control cybersecurity risks and limit lateral movement across the environment.
classification_rationale: Preventive technical safeguard isolating network segments; maps to Network&Comms Security.

definition_short_en: The application verifies the X.509 certificate of the remote endpoint and enforces Transport Layer Security for all network communications, preventing interception and man-in-the-middle attacks.
classification_rationale: Application-level control verifying certificates and enforcing TLS; an app security verification requirement mapped to SD-05.02.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may remove network share connections that are no longer useful in order to clean up and hide traces of their operation and evade detection.
classification_rationale: Adversary defense-evasion technique removing share connections; classified as a threat under Threat Detection&Alerts.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may passively sniff network traffic to capture credentials, configuration details, and other information about an environment for reconnaissance or later exploitation.
classification_rationale: Passive traffic interception technique; a threat under Network&Comms Security.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for the entity's network security management must be defined and implemented to govern protection of network infrastructure and communications.
classification_rationale: High-level mandated outcome to implement network security management requirements; a governance requirement under Network&Comms Security.

definition_short_en: Logically or physically isolate and segment network segments securely using firewalls and defense-in-depth to control cybersecurity risks as part of network security management.
classification_rationale: Preventive segmentation safeguard within network management; maps to Network&Comms Security.

definition_short_en: Employ system components with no writeable storage that persists across component restart or power cycling, reducing malware persistence and unauthorized data retention risks.
classification_rationale: Preventive hardening control using non-persistent storage on system components; maps to Systems,Servers&Endpoint.

definition_short_en: Load and execute non-modifiable executable programs from read-only media to prevent tampering, unauthorized code modification, and malware persistence on system components.
classification_rationale: Preventive hardening control executing immutable programs from read-only media; maps to Configuration&Hardening.

definition_short_en: Verify that the client, acting as the relying party, mitigates ID Token replay attacks in OpenID Connect flows to prevent reuse of intercepted authentication tokens.
classification_rationale: OIDC authentication control mitigating ID token replay; maps to Authentication&MFA (identity/authentication focus).

definition_short_en: Verify that the authorization server validates redirect URIs against a client-specific allowlist of pre-registered URIs using exact string comparison to prevent open redirect and token theft.
classification_rationale: OAuth authorization server control enforcing exact redirect URI allowlisting; authentication/authorization safeguard mapped to SD-03.02.

definition_short_en: Verify that the resource server prevents use or replay of stolen access tokens by requiring sender-constrained access tokens bound to the legitimate client.
classification_rationale: OAuth control binding access tokens to sender to prevent token theft/replay; maps to Authentication&MFA.

definition_short_en: Use security and privacy attributes associated with subjects and objects to enforce information flow control decisions, restricting data movement based on classification and access rules.
classification_rationale: Preventive control using subject/object attributes to enforce flow control; maps to Authorization&LeastPrivilege.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may encode data using a standard data encoding system to make the content of command-and-control traffic more difficult to detect and analyze.
classification_rationale: Adversary obfuscation technique encoding C2 traffic to evade detection; a threat under Threat Detection&Alerts.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its contents to evade defenses.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique obfuscating files to evade analysis; a threat under Threat Detection&Alerts.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may obfuscate content during command execution to impede detection by monitoring tools and security analysts, hindering identification of malicious activity.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique obfuscating commands to evade detection; a threat under Threat Detection&Alerts.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may make a payload difficult to analyze by removing symbols, strings, and other human-readable information, hindering reverse engineering and detection efforts.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique stripping payload symbols to impede analysis; a threat under Threat Detection&Alerts.

definition_short_en: Maintain exclusive organizational control of cryptographic keys used for material stored or transmitted through external systems, preventing third parties from accessing protected data.
