classification_rationale: Preventive control retaining exclusive key control for encrypted external data; maps to Data Protection&Encryption.

definition_short_en: Verify that the application only uses client-side technologies that are still supported and considered secure, avoiding deprecated or vulnerable browser components.
classification_rationale: Application control ensuring only supported/secure client-side technologies are used; maps to App&API Security Testing.

definition_short_en: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are issued, managed, verified, and revoked by the organization throughout their lifecycle.
classification_rationale: NIST CSF PR.AA-01 outcome requiring managed identities and credentials; a governance/standard requirement under Identity Lifecycle.

definition_short_en: Identities must be proofed and bound to issued credentials according to the risk context of the interaction, ensuring credentials are tied to verified, legitimate identity owners.
classification_rationale: Outcome-based identity lifecycle requirement (NIST CSF PR.AA-02) mandating proofing and credential binding by interaction context.

definition_short_en: Adversaries reuse stolen Kerberos tickets to authenticate and move laterally across systems without knowing plaintext credentials, enabling unauthorized access throughout the environment.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique describing stolen Kerberos ticket reuse for lateral movement; modeled as an authentication-domain threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries patch or modify cloud authentication mechanisms tied to on-premises identities to insert backdoors, allowing persistent unauthorized authentication and account takeover.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique tampering with hybrid cloud authentication processes; a threat targeting authentication integrity.

definition_short_en: Adversaries abuse sudo caching or manipulate the sudoers configuration file to elevate privileges on Unix-like systems, gaining root-level unauthorized access.
classification_rationale: Privilege escalation technique via sudo mechanisms; classified as a privileged-access threat.

definition_short_en: An adversary with root access extracts stored credentials from the macOS Keychain, obtaining plaintext secrets that enable further unauthorized access and credential misuse.
classification_rationale: Credential access technique harvesting secrets from a credential store; an authentication-domain threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries enumerate the primary user, current logged-in user, or common system users to profile targets and plan follow-on actions during reconnaissance.
classification_rationale: Account/user discovery reconnaissance technique; modeled as an identity-domain threat supporting later attack stages.

definition_short_en: Adversaries scan local file systems and remote shares for files containing insecurely stored credentials, harvesting exposed secrets to expand access and exfiltrate data.
classification_rationale: Credential access technique searching storage for exposed secrets; an authentication-domain threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries apply password cracking against captured hashes to recover usable plaintext credentials, enabling authenticated access to accounts and systems.
classification_rationale: Offline credential recovery technique via cracking; classified as an authentication threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries try a single or small set of common passwords across many accounts to evade lockouts and acquire valid credentials for unauthorized access.
classification_rationale: Password spraying brute-force technique against many accounts; an authentication-domain threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries subvert a network device's encryption capability to bypass protections, exposing data communications to interception and manipulation across the network.
classification_rationale: Technique weakening network device encryption to expose traffic; a network-communications security threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries holding the KRBTGT account hash forge Kerberos ticket-granting tickets to impersonate any user, obtaining domain-wide persistent unauthorized access.
classification_rationale: Golden Ticket forgery grants domain-wide privileged impersonation; a high-impact privileged-access threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries query the Windows Registry on compromised systems to locate insecurely stored credentials, harvesting secrets that enable further authenticated access.
classification_rationale: Credential access technique searching the Registry for stored secrets; an authentication-domain threat.

definition_short_en: Establishes organizational standards for creating strong passwords, protecting them from disclosure, and defining change frequency to reduce credential compromise risk across systems.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement setting password strength, protection, and rotation standards; an authentication policy.

definition_short_en: User-set passwords must be at least eight characters in length, with a minimum of fifteen characters strongly recommended, to resist guessing and cracking attacks.
classification_rationale: Verifiable configuration baseline specifying minimum password length; an authentication standard.

definition_short_en: Adversaries use social engineering to influence users into taking actions such as running content or granting access, resulting in unauthorized access to systems.
classification_rationale: User-manipulation technique exploiting human behavior; a people-domain social engineering threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries hide information within benign-looking files using steganography to conceal payloads or data, evading detection by security monitoring and content inspection.
classification_rationale: Defense-evasion technique concealing data via steganography; a detection-domain threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries alter file time attributes (timestomping) to disguise new or modified files, undermining forensic timelines and evading detection during investigations.
classification_rationale: Timestomping defense-evasion technique obscuring file changes; a detection/monitoring threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries execute malicious payloads by side-loading crafted DLLs into legitimate applications, abusing trusted processes to run code and evade defenses.
classification_rationale: DLL side-loading execution technique abusing trusted binaries on endpoints; a systems/endpoint threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries inject malicious code into legitimate processes to evade process-based defenses and potentially elevate privileges while masking activity within trusted execution contexts.
classification_rationale: Process injection technique for evasion and privilege escalation on endpoints; a systems/endpoint threat.

title_en: HTML Smuggling Content Filter Bypass Threat
definition_short_en: Adversaries hide malicious payloads inside seemingly benign HTML files to smuggle data past web and email content filters, delivering malware to endpoints.
classification_rationale: HTML smuggling technique evading content filters over web/email channels; an email/web comms threat.

definition_short_en: Adversaries abuse PowerShell commands and scripts to execute malicious code, leveraging a trusted built-in tool to run payloads and evade traditional defenses.
classification_rationale: Living-off-the-land execution technique abusing PowerShell on endpoints; a systems/endpoint threat.

definition_short_en: Penetration testing must be conducted at least annually and after major changes to the environment to identify exploitable weaknesses before adversaries do.
classification_rationale: Detective control requiring recurring and change-triggered penetration testing; a security testing/assessment safeguard.

definition_short_en: Penetration testing is conducted to assess the efficiency and effectiveness of deployed defense mechanisms, validating whether controls withstand realistic attack scenarios.
classification_rationale: Detective control using penetration testing to evaluate defense efficiency; a security testing/assessment safeguard.

definition_short_en: Security controls in the system are assessed and monitored on an ongoing basis to confirm they remain implemented and effective over time.
classification_rationale: Continuous control assessment and monitoring safeguard; a detective assessment control despite the penetration-testing title.

definition_short_en: An independent penetration testing agent or team must be employed to perform testing, ensuring objective, unbiased assessment free of internal conflicts of interest.
classification_rationale: Organizational control requiring independent testers for objective penetration testing; a security assessment safeguard.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a formal penetration testing program scaled to the enterprise's size and complexity to systematically probe defenses and identify exploitable weaknesses.
classification_rationale: A structured, ongoing penetration testing program is a program artifact under security testing and assessments (SD-06.04).

definition_short_en: Employ specialized security assessments to independently verify that implemented controls operate effectively and deliver their intended protective outcomes across the environment.
classification_rationale: Specialized assessments to verify control effectiveness are a detective testing control under security assessments (SD-06.04).

definition_short_en: Perform penetration testing and analysis as an integral part of the vulnerability management process to validate and prioritize identified weaknesses.
classification_rationale: Penetration testing performed within vulnerability management (RA-5) maps to detective testing under vulnerability and patch management (SD-06.03).

definition_short_en: Perform structured penetration testing and red-team exercises that simulate real-world attacks to validate the effectiveness of defensive controls across the infrastructure.
classification_rationale: Red teaming simulating real-world attacks to validate defenses is a detective testing control under security testing and assessments (SD-06.04).

definition_short_en: Conduct penetration testing and analysis of supply chain elements, processes, and actors to identify weaknesses introduced through third-party dependencies and integrations.
classification_rationale: Testing of supply chain elements and actors (SA-12) is a detective control focused on third-party and supply risk (SD-08.03).

title_en: Penetration Testing Scope For External Services
definition_short_en: Define penetration testing scope to include all externally provided internet-facing services and their technical components, ensuring the exposed attack surface is fully assessed.
classification_rationale: Requiring pen test scope to cover all internet-facing services defines a detective testing control under security assessments (SD-06.04).

definition_short_en: The entity's cybersecurity department must periodically review the implementation of cybersecurity controls to confirm they remain in place and effective over time.
classification_rationale: Internal periodic review of control implementation is an organizational detective control under compliance, audit and assurance (SD-01.04).

definition_short_en: Implementation of cybersecurity controls must be reviewed and audited by parties independent of the entity's cybersecurity department to ensure objective assurance.
classification_rationale: Independent audit by parties outside the cybersecurity department is an organizational detective assurance control (SD-01.04).

definition_short_en: Results of cybersecurity audits and reviews must be documented and presented to the cybersecurity supervisory committee and the Authorized Official for oversight and action.
classification_rationale: Documenting and reporting audit results to governance bodies is an organizational assurance control under compliance and audit (SD-01.04).

definition_short_en: Identify and define the specific actions that may be performed on a system without prior identification or authentication, limiting anonymous access to an approved minimum.
classification_rationale: Defining actions allowed without authentication (AC-14) is a preventive access control under authentication (SD-03.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may install bootkits that infect the boot process below the operating system to maintain stealthy persistence across reboots and evade detection.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary boot-level persistence technique, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of default accounts to gain initial access and persistence, exploiting unchanged or well-known factory credentials.
classification_rationale: Describes abuse of default account credentials for access, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may achieve persistence by adding a program to a startup folder or referencing it with a Registry run key so it executes at system boot.
classification_rationale: Describes registry run key / startup folder persistence technique, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may establish persistence or elevate privileges using system mechanisms that automatically trigger execution of malicious code based on specific events.
classification_rationale: Describes event-triggered execution for persistence/privilege escalation, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may create or modify launch agents to repeatedly execute malicious payloads at login or boot, maintaining persistence on macOS systems.
classification_rationale: Describes launch agent persistence technique, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse the cron utility to schedule initial or recurring execution of malicious code, establishing persistence on Unix-like systems.
classification_rationale: Describes cron-based scheduled task persistence, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may use Windows logon scripts that execute automatically at logon initialization to run malicious code and establish persistence.
classification_rationale: Describes Windows logon script persistence technique, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may use startup items that execute automatically at boot initialization to run malicious payloads and establish persistence on a host.
classification_rationale: Describes startup item boot persistence technique, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may use traffic signaling to hide open ports or trigger malicious functionality used for persistence, evading network monitoring and detection.
classification_rationale: Describes traffic signaling to conceal persistence functionality, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may leverage Microsoft Office-based applications to persist between startups by abusing add-ins, templates, or macros that execute at launch.
classification_rationale: Describes Office application-based persistence technique, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may set up email forwarding rules in mail clients such as Outlook to covertly collect and exfiltrate sensitive information from a compromised mailbox.
classification_rationale: Describes malicious email forwarding rules for data collection, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may establish persistence by executing malicious content triggered through AppInit DLLs that are loaded into processes at startup.
classification_rationale: Describes AppInit DLL persistence and privilege abuse technique, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

title_en: Registry Run Key Startup Persistence Threat
definition_short_en: Adversaries may achieve persistence by adding a program to a startup folder or referencing it with a Registry run key so it launches automatically at logon.
classification_rationale: Describes registry run key / startup folder persistence technique, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may clear artifacts associated with previously established persistence on a host to remove evidence of their activity and hinder detection and forensics.
classification_rationale: Describes defense-evasion clearing of persistence artifacts, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may create or modify Windows services to repeatedly execute malicious payloads at system start, maintaining persistence with elevated privileges.
classification_rationale: Describes Windows service creation/modification for persistence, a threat under threat detection and alerts (SD-06.02).

title_en: Minimize PII in Testing and Training
definition_short_en: Limit and avoid the use of personally identifiable information within research, testing, or training activities to reduce exposure of real personal data in non-production contexts.
classification_rationale: Data minimization safeguard for non-production PII maps to privacy and retention control under SD-02.05.

definition_short_en: Adversaries create or generate content such as lures and messaging to support targeting and phishing operations against intended victims, enabling social engineering campaigns.
classification_rationale: Adversary technique describing phishing content creation is a threat mapped to threat intelligence and IoCs.

definition_short_en: Adversaries send spearphishing emails carrying malicious attachments to trick recipients into execution, seeking initial access to victim systems and networks.
classification_rationale: Spearphishing attachment initial-access technique is an adversary threat mapped to threat intelligence.

definition_short_en: Adversaries use valid or stolen account credentials to log into remote machines over Secure Shell, blending in with legitimate authenticated access to systems.
classification_rationale: Adversary use of valid accounts over SSH is a credential-based threat technique catalogued as threat intelligence.

definition_short_en: Adversaries exploit weaknesses in an Internet-facing host or system to gain initial access to a target network, leveraging unpatched or vulnerable exposed services.
classification_rationale: Exploitation of Internet-facing systems for initial access is an adversary threat technique in threat intelligence.

definition_short_en: Adversaries send phishing messages across channels to deceive recipients and gain initial access to victim systems through social engineering and credential capture.
classification_rationale: Generic phishing initial-access technique is an adversary threat mapped to threat intelligence.

definition_short_en: Adversaries send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems, tricking users into revealing credentials or executing malicious content for entry.
classification_rationale: Phishing access technique is an adversary threat entry mapped to threat intelligence and IoCs.

definition_short_en: Provide personnel training in the employment and operation of environmental controls so staff can correctly manage protective systems safeguarding facilities and equipment.
classification_rationale: Training provision on environmental controls is a human-nature awareness and training control under SD-08.01.

definition_short_en: Ensure all sensitive and confidential information, whether on paper or in electronic form, is secured in the workspace to prevent unauthorized viewing or removal.
classification_rationale: Clean desk practice securing information in the physical workspace is a physical and environmental protection control.

definition_short_en: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality and integrity of information during transmission, preventing interception and tampering across communication channels.
classification_rationale: Encryption safeguarding data in transit is a technical data protection and encryption control under SD-02.04.

definition_short_en: Employ and maintain fire detection and suppression systems to protect facilities, equipment, and personnel from fire damage and ensure continued operations.
classification_rationale: Fire detection and suppression is a physical environmental safeguard mapped to SD-08.04.

definition_short_en: Require validation and verification of identity evidence to be conducted in person before a designated registration authority prior to issuing credentials or access.
classification_rationale: In-person identity proofing during registration is an identity lifecycle control under SD-03.01.

definition_short_en: Enforce information-sharing decisions by authorized users based on access authorizations of sharing partners and access restrictions applicable to the information being shared.
classification_rationale: Enforcing sharing decisions per access authorizations is an authorization and least-privilege control under SD-03.03.

definition_short_en: Separate user functionality, including user interface services, from system management functionality to reduce exposure of administrative interfaces to ordinary users.
classification_rationale: Separation of user from management functionality is a system hardening and configuration control under SD-04.03.

definition_short_en: Establish and manage cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle whenever cryptography is employed within the system, ensuring secure generation, storage, and rotation.
classification_rationale: Cryptographic key lifecycle management is a technical data protection and encryption control under SD-02.04.

definition_short_en: Restrict the use of maintenance tools to authorized personnel only, preventing misuse of diagnostic and repair utilities that could compromise system security.
classification_rationale: Restricting maintenance tool use to authorized staff is a systems and endpoint control under SD-04.02.

definition_short_en: Mark system components indicating the impact level or classification level of information permitted to be processed, stored, or transmitted on those components.
classification_rationale: Marking components by classification or impact level is a data classification control under SD-02.03.

definition_short_en: Restrict access to media and storage devices to authorized individuals to prevent unauthorized reading, copying, removal, or loss of stored data.
classification_rationale: Restricting physical access to media and storage devices is a physical protection control under SD-08.04.

definition_short_en: Monitor the physical environment to find potentially adverse events, enabling timely detection of intrusions, hazards, or anomalies affecting facilities and assets.
classification_rationale: Monitoring the physical environment for adverse events is a detective physical and environmental control under SD-08.04.

title_en: Correlate Audit and Physical Access Records
definition_short_en: Correlate information from audit records with physical access monitoring data to enhance the ability to identify suspicious activity across digital and physical domains.
classification_rationale: Correlating audit and physical access records for detection is a logging and monitoring control under SD-06.01.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements protecting information and technology assets against unauthorized physical access, loss, theft, and damage must be identified, documented, and formally approved.
classification_rationale: Mandated definition, documentation, and approval of physical protection requirements is a governance requirement under SD-08.04.

definition_short_en: Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides to detect and record unauthorized entry attempts and support incident investigation.
classification_rationale: Monitoring physical access to facilities is a detective physical and environmental control under SD-08.04.

definition_short_en: Implement software-enforced separation and policy enforcement mechanisms to isolate processes and enforce security boundaries between components within the system.
classification_rationale: Software-enforced separation and policy enforcement is a technical hardening and configuration control under SD-04.03.

definition_short_en: Protect power equipment and power cabling for the system from damage and destruction to maintain availability and prevent disruption of critical operations.
classification_rationale: Protecting power equipment and cabling from damage is a physical and environmental protection control under SD-08.04.

title_en: Disable Collaborative Devices in Secure Areas
definition_short_en: Disable or remove collaborative computing devices and applications such as cameras and microphones from secure work areas to prevent eavesdropping and surveillance.
classification_rationale: Removing collaborative computing devices from secure areas prevents surveillance and is a physical protection control under SD-08.04.

title_en: Authorized Physical Access to Critical Areas
definition_short_en: Restrict entry to critical facility areas so that only authorized personnel can physically access sensitive assets, protecting equipment and information from unauthorized physical presence.
classification_rationale: Physical access restriction to critical areas is a preventive physical safeguard belonging to physical and environmental security.

definition_short_en: Configure Pluggable Authentication Modules to enforce strong password creation rules including complexity, minimum length, and expiration policies for system account credentials.
classification_rationale: Technical configuration of PAM to enforce password parameters is a baseline setting supporting authentication.

definition_short_en: Adversaries manipulate CI/CD build processes by injecting malicious code into the pipeline, compromising software artifacts before release and enabling supply chain compromise.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique against CI/CD pipelines, i.e. a threat within code/supply chain security.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be reviewed and updated at planned intervals or when relevant legislative, regulatory, or standards requirements change.
classification_rationale: Mandatory outcome requiring periodic policy review is a governance requirement over policies and standards.

definition_short_en: Develop, document, and disseminate organizational privacy policies and procedures governing the handling and protection of personal and sensitive data.
classification_rationale: Establishing privacy policies and procedures is a governing policy statement within privacy and data protection.

definition_short_en: Develop, document, and disseminate access control policies and procedures governing how identity and access management is administered across the organization.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement for access control belongs to identity and access authorization.

definition_short_en: Develop, document, and disseminate configuration management policies and procedures governing how infrastructure system configurations are established and maintained.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement for configuration management maps to infrastructure configuration and hardening.

definition_short_en: Develop, document, and disseminate personnel security policies and procedures governing security responsibilities and controls applied to employees and workforce members.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement for personnel security maps to insider and personnel security.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity risk management policy is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and the organizational mission.
classification_rationale: Governing policy statement for managing cybersecurity risk, maintained and enforced, is a GRC policy.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity risk management policy is established based on organizational context, strategy, and priorities, then communicated and enforced across the organization.
classification_rationale: Establishing a cybersecurity risk policy from organizational context is a governing GRC policy statement.

definition_short_en: Notify individuals of applicable legally binding post-employment requirements for protecting organizational information after their departure from the organization.
classification_rationale: Notifying departing staff of binding post-employment obligations is a human control tied to legal/HR terminations.

definition_short_en: Take system components out of service by transferring their responsibilities to substitute components before the mean time to failure is reached, preserving availability.
classification_rationale: Proactive component substitution to avoid failure supports resilience and disaster recovery availability.

definition_short_en: Notify the user upon successful logon of the date and time of their last logon, helping detect unauthorized use of the account.
classification_rationale: Displaying last logon time is a detective authentication control helping users spot unauthorized access.

definition_short_en: Include Privacy Act statements on forms that collect information maintained in a Privacy Act system of records, informing individuals of data collection purposes.
classification_rationale: Providing privacy notices on collection forms is an organizational privacy control within data privacy.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities to elevate their privileges on a system, gaining higher access than originally authorized.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary privilege-elevation technique, a threat relevant to privileged access.

definition_short_en: Limit privileges to change system components and system-related information within production or operational environments to authorized personnel only.
classification_rationale: Restricting change privileges in production enforces least privilege over authorization.

definition_short_en: Monitor and control remote access methods to the system, ensuring remote connections are authorized, tracked, and restricted to approved channels.
classification_rationale: Monitoring and controlling remote access methods is a detective/preventive control over privileged and remote access.

definition_short_en: Restrict privileged accounts on the system to defined personnel or roles, ensuring elevated access is granted only to explicitly authorized individuals.
classification_rationale: Restricting privileged accounts to defined roles is a preventive privileged access control.

definition_short_en: Identity and access management requirements must include, as a minimum, single-factor authentication based on username and password for entity systems.
classification_rationale: Mandatory baseline requirement specifying minimum authentication (username/password) maps to authentication.

definition_short_en: Prevent execution of programs on systems in accordance with defined policies, blocking unauthorized or disallowed software from running.
classification_rationale: Preventing program execution per policy (application allow/deny listing) is a preventive endpoint control.

definition_short_en: Monitor privileged role or attribute assignments and revoke access when it is no longer appropriate, ensuring elevated permissions remain justified.
classification_rationale: Monitoring privileged assignments and revoking stale access is a detective access review control.

definition_short_en: Implement additional monitoring of privileged users to detect misuse or anomalous behavior by accounts holding elevated system permissions.
classification_rationale: Additional monitoring of privileged users is a detective privileged access control.

definition_short_en: Scan systems for vulnerabilities and take corrective actions to remediate identified weaknesses before they can be exploited by adversaries.
classification_rationale: Scanning for vulnerabilities and remediating maps to vulnerability and patch management.

definition_short_en: Implement the Enterprise Access (Tiered Administration) Model to separate high-privilege Tier 0 identities from standard Tier 2 endpoints, limiting lateral compromise.
classification_rationale: Tiered administration segregating privileged identities from endpoints is a preventive privileged access control.

definition_short_en: Isolate, manage, and monitor highly privileged accounts to prevent their abuse, centralizing control over elevated credentials and their usage.
classification_rationale: Isolating, managing, and monitoring privileged accounts is the core privileged access management control.

definition_short_en: Provide mechanisms enabling individuals to tailor and manage processing permissions for selected elements of their personally identifiable information, supporting granular consent choices.
classification_rationale: Technical safeguard giving individuals granular consent control over PII processing; privacy domain.

definition_short_en: Prohibit the use of system account identifiers for individual accounts that are identical to public identifiers, reducing exposure of account credentials to enumeration.
classification_rationale: Account identifier hygiene control within identity lifecycle to prevent guessable public identifiers.

definition_short_en: Prohibit the use of devices whose purpose is to collect information, preventing covert data gathering and surveillance within organizational environments.
classification_rationale: Physical control restricting information-collection devices to prevent covert surveillance; physical/environmental domain.

definition_short_en: Protect large language model applications against crafted prompts that trick the model into executing unintended instructions or revealing sensitive data, using input handling safeguards.
classification_rationale: Application-layer safeguard against LLM prompt injection; app/API security testing domain.

definition_short_en: Detect adversarial prompts embedding malicious instructions that force a large language model to execute unintended commands, through monitoring of model inputs and behavior.
classification_rationale: Detective monitoring of prompt injection attempts against LLMs; threat detection domain.

definition_short_en: Protect system media that is transported or stored outside of controlled areas, safeguarding confidentiality and integrity of information during movement beyond secure perimeters.
classification_rationale: Media protection outside secure areas; data protection domain with physical handling nature.

definition_short_en: Protect security monitoring information from unauthorized access and modification, preserving the integrity and confidentiality of logs and detection data used for oversight.
classification_rationale: Safeguard protecting monitoring/log data integrity and access; logging and monitoring domain.

definition_short_en: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information stored on media using cryptographic mechanisms, preventing unauthorized disclosure or tampering of at-rest data.
classification_rationale: Cryptographic safeguard for media confidentiality and integrity; data protection and encryption domain.

definition_short_en: Establish a public reporting channel to receive external reports of vulnerabilities in organizational systems and components, enabling coordinated disclosure and remediation.
classification_rationale: Establishment of a public vulnerability disclosure program; vulnerability management domain.

definition_short_en: Provide and implement capability to audit the parameters of user query events for data sets containing personally identifiable information, supporting accountability and misuse detection.
classification_rationale: Detective audit capability over PII query parameters; logging and monitoring domain.

definition_short_en: Communicate recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities to designated internal and external stakeholders during and after a disruptive event.
classification_rationale: Required outcome of communicating recovery progress to stakeholders; crisis communications domain.

title_en: Source Refresh Software From Trusted Sources
definition_short_en: Obtain software and data used during system component and service refreshes from trusted sources, ensuring supply chain integrity of refreshed elements.
classification_rationale: Supply chain integrity control sourcing refresh software from trusted origins; components and supply chain domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for cryptography must incorporate at least the requirements of the National Cryptographic Standards published by the NCA, ensuring regulatory alignment.
classification_rationale: Regulatory requirement mandating conformance to national cryptographic standards; encryption domain.

definition_short_en: Ensure identified vulnerabilities are remediated based on risk severity and immediately re-tested to verify successful mitigation before closure of findings.
classification_rationale: Corrective control remediating and re-testing vulnerabilities by severity; vulnerability and patch management domain.

title_en: Report Collected Data To Authorized Roles Only
definition_short_en: Verify that the system is configured so that collected data or information is reported only to authorized individuals or roles, preventing unauthorized disclosure.
classification_rationale: Authorization control limiting reporting of collected data to authorized roles; authorization and least privilege domain.

definition_short_en: Verify the integrity of restored assets, restore systems and services, and confirm return to normal operating status following recovery from a disruption.
classification_rationale: Required recovery outcome verifying restored asset integrity and normal operations; disaster recovery domain.

definition_short_en: Restrict the use of system maintenance tools to authorized personnel only, preventing misuse of privileged maintenance capabilities against organizational systems.
classification_rationale: Access restriction on maintenance tools to authorized personnel; privileged access domain.

definition_short_en: Retain previous versions of system baseline configurations to support rollback, enabling restoration of a known-good state after failed or malicious changes.
classification_rationale: Recovery-oriented control retaining prior baselines for rollback; configuration and hardening domain.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity department must identify, document, and approve the entity's cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures, aligning risk practices across the enterprise.
classification_rationale: Documented and approved risk management methodology and procedures; risk management domain.

definition_short_en: Develop and implement an organization-wide risk management strategy that guides how cybersecurity risks are identified, assessed, and treated across the enterprise.
classification_rationale: Development of an organizational risk management strategy; risk management domain.

definition_short_en: Artificial intelligence risks are prioritized based on assessments from the Map and Measure functions, informing allocation of risk treatment resources.
classification_rationale: Requirement to prioritize AI risks based on assessment outputs; risk management domain.

definition_short_en: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders, providing an approved basis for measuring and steering the risk program.
classification_rationale: Establishment of stakeholder-agreed risk management objectives; governance risk domain.

title_en: Respond to Assessment and Audit Findings
definition_short_en: Respond to findings from security and privacy assessments, monitoring, and audits in accordance with organizational risk tolerance, ensuring timely and proportionate treatment.
classification_rationale: Requirement to respond to assessment, monitoring, and audit findings per risk tolerance; compliance and audit domain.

definition_short_en: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed to identify adjustments needed, supporting continuous improvement of the risk program.
classification_rationale: Requirement to evaluate risk management performance for improvement; program management and metrics domain.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure ongoing coverage of organizational requirements and evolving risks.
classification_rationale: Requirement to periodically review and adjust the risk management strategy; risk management domain.

definition_short_en: Establish and gain stakeholder agreement on a cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, including its strategy, objectives, policies, and processes for managing third-party and supplier risk.
classification_rationale: A stakeholder-agreed supply chain risk management program with strategy and policies is a governance-level program in third-party risk (SD-08.03).

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a documented risk-based remediation strategy and process, conducting reviews at least monthly or more frequently to prioritize and track fixing of identified weaknesses.
classification_rationale: A documented remediation strategy with periodic reviews is a procedure supporting vulnerability and patch remediation (SD-06.03).

definition_short_en: Enforce a role-based access control policy that governs which defined subjects may act on which defined objects, aligning permissions with job roles to limit access.
classification_rationale: RBAC enforcement over subjects and objects is a preventive technical control for authorization and least privilege (SD-03.03).

definition_short_en: Establish and document rules of behavior describing acceptable use and responsibilities for system users, setting expectations for how personnel must interact with organizational systems and information.
classification_rationale: Documented rules of behavior for users are a policy statement governing personnel conduct (SD-08.02).

title_en: Restrict SAM Access and Remote Calls
definition_short_en: Restrict access to the Security Account Manager and remote SAM calls to prevent adversaries from harvesting credentials and escalating privileges on Windows systems.
classification_rationale: Restricting SAM access is a preventive technical hardening control on endpoint configuration to block privilege escalation (SD-04.03).

definition_short_en: Configure the SSH daemon for secure communication by disabling root login and empty passwords and enforcing strong ciphers and message authentication codes to protect remote access.
classification_rationale: Specific SSH daemon hardening settings constitute a technical configuration baseline (SD-04.03).

definition_short_en: Verify that all untrusted HTML input from WYSIWYG editors or similar sources is sanitized using a well-known, secure HTML sanitization library to prevent cross-site scripting.
classification_rationale: HTML input sanitization is a preventive technical application-security control verified through testing (SD-05.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts to execute malicious code, leveraging a trusted built-in interpreter to run payloads while evading detection on Windows systems.
classification_rationale: This describes an adversary technique (PowerShell abuse), so it is a threat relevant to threat detection (SD-06.02).

definition_short_en: Adversaries may search freely available websites and domains to gather information about victims that can be used to plan and support targeting during pre-attack reconnaissance.
classification_rationale: This describes an adversary open-source reconnaissance technique, a threat relevant to threat intelligence (SD-06.05).

definition_short_en: Apply secure baselines, golden images, and hardening to enterprise assets, with drift management and reliable time synchronization to maintain consistent, verifiable secure configurations over time.
classification_rationale: Secure baselines, golden images, hardening and drift management are a preventive technical configuration-hardening control (SD-04.03).

definition_short_en: Software development personnel are trained in software security including secure coding techniques, in accordance with industry best practices and organizational requirements, to reduce introduction of vulnerabilities.
classification_rationale: A required outcome that developers be trained in secure coding is a governance requirement within AppSec SDLC governance (SD-05.01).

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process for enterprise assets and software, providing a repeatable method to define, apply, and sustain hardened settings across the environment.
classification_rationale: Establishing and maintaining a secure configuration process is a procedure supporting configuration and hardening (SD-04.03).

definition_short_en: Verify that industry-validated implementations, including trusted libraries and hardware-accelerated modules, are used for all cryptographic operations rather than custom or unvetted cryptography.
classification_rationale: Requiring validated crypto libraries is a preventive technical control for data protection and encryption (SD-02.04).

definition_short_en: Implement the security design principle of secure distributed composition, ensuring that composing distributed components preserves the security properties each component provides across the overall system.
classification_rationale: A named security design principle applied during architecture is a principle within AppSec/SDLC governance (SD-05.01).

definition_short_en: Provide a secure name and address resolution service, protecting DNS integrity and authenticity so that clients receive trustworthy resolution data and resist spoofing or tampering.
classification_rationale: A secure DNS/name resolution service is a preventive technical network and communications security control (SD-04.01).

title_en: Secure Development Process with Peer Review
definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a secure software development process whose acceptance criteria include requiring peer code review and performing threat modeling before releasing software into production.
classification_rationale: A secure development process with peer review and threat modeling acceptance criteria is an SDLC procedure (SD-05.01).

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for project management and technology asset changes must include, at minimum, vulnerability assessment and remediation to identify and fix weaknesses before and after changes.
classification_rationale: A mandatory requirement to include vulnerability assessment and remediation in change requirements is a governance requirement mapped to vulnerability management (SD-06.03).

definition_short_en: Secure software development practices are integrated into and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle, ensuring security is sustained rather than applied only once.
classification_rationale: A required outcome that secure development practices be integrated and monitored across the SDLC is a governance requirement (SD-05.01).

definition_short_en: Embed security across development by defining security requirements, performing code review, applying security gates, and managing software supply-chain and dependency risk throughout the lifecycle.
classification_rationale: An end-to-end secure SDLC bundling requirements, review, gates and dependency management is a process in AppSec SDLC governance (SD-05.01); it bundles multiple ideas.

title_en: Receive and Respond to Security Advisories
definition_short_en: Receive and respond to security alerts, advisories, and directives from external and internal sources, ensuring timely awareness and action on emerging threats and required protective measures.
classification_rationale: Receiving and acting on security alerts and advisories is a detective organizational control tied to threat intelligence (SD-06.05).

definition_short_en: Associate security and privacy attributes with information exchanged between systems and system components, enabling consistent enforcement of handling, access, and protection decisions as data moves.
classification_rationale: Binding security/privacy attributes (labels) to exchanged information is a preventive technical control supporting data classification (SD-02.03).

definition_short_en: Apply systems security and privacy engineering principles in the specification, design, development, implementation, and modification of the system to build protection in from the outset.
classification_rationale: Applying security and privacy engineering principles across the system lifecycle is a governing principle within AppSec/SDLC governance (SD-05.01).

definition_short_en: Verify the correct operation of security and privacy functions, confirming that implemented safeguards perform as intended through defined checks at transitional states or on demand.
classification_rationale: Verifying that security functions operate correctly is a detective technical control aligned to security testing and assessments (SD-06.04).

definition_short_en: Provide security awareness training to personnel so that staff understand threats, policies, and their responsibilities for protecting organizational information and systems from compromise.
classification_rationale: A required outcome to provide awareness training to personnel is a governance requirement in awareness and training (SD-08.01).

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a security awareness program that continuously educates personnel and relevant third parties on security risks and expected behaviors across the organization.
classification_rationale: Establishing and maintaining an ongoing security awareness program is a program in awareness and training (SD-08.01).

definition_short_en: Personnel holding roles directly tied to cybersecurity must receive specialized skills development and necessary training to competently perform their security-related duties.
classification_rationale: A required outcome for specialized training of security staff maps to ART-REQ under awareness/training domain SD-08.01.

definition_short_en: The entity must periodically develop and formally approve a cybersecurity awareness program delivered across multiple communication channels to reach all relevant staff.
classification_rationale: A structured, approved awareness program delivered through channels is ART-PRG in SD-08.01.

definition_short_en: Provide training that enables personnel to recognize suspicious communications and detect anomalous behavior within organizational systems, improving early reporting of potential threats.
classification_rationale: Training staff to detect suspicious behavior is a human detective safeguard in awareness domain SD-08.01.

definition_short_en: Verify that personnel performing maintenance and diagnostic activities on systems processing classified information hold the appropriate security clearances before granting such access.
classification_rationale: Verifying clearances of maintenance staff is a preventive personnel-security control in SD-08.02.

definition_short_en: Review system and network device configurations against established secure baselines to detect unauthorized or insecure changes and drift from approved hardening standards.
classification_rationale: Reviewing configs against baselines to detect drift is a detective hardening control in SD-04.03.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity event logging must be activated and enabled for critical information assets to ensure security-relevant activity is captured and available for review.
classification_rationale: Enabling event logs on critical assets is a technical detective logging control in SD-06.01.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for event logging and monitoring management must be identified, documented, and formally approved to establish a governed logging baseline.
classification_rationale: Identifying, documenting and approving logging/monitoring requirements is a governance requirement in SD-06.01.

definition_short_en: Implement physical security controls and monitor physical access to facilities and information assets to prevent and detect unauthorized entry.
classification_rationale: Physical access controls and monitoring are physical preventive controls in SD-08.04 (title mislabeled).

definition_short_en: Verify that all authentication operations are logged, capturing both successful and unsuccessful attempts to support detection of credential abuse and account compromise.
classification_rationale: Logging all authentication attempts is a technical detective logging control in SD-06.01.

definition_short_en: Require the developer of a system, component, or service to provide a plan for continuous monitoring of security control effectiveness throughout the lifecycle.
classification_rationale: A developer-provided continuous monitoring plan for control effectiveness is ART-PLN within AppSec SDLC governance SD-05.01.

definition_short_en: An overall information security policy must be established, published, maintained, and disseminated to all relevant personnel to direct the organization's security posture.
classification_rationale: An established, published information security policy is ART-POL in policies/standards domain SD-01.02.

definition_short_en: Implement the security design principle of self-reliant trustworthiness so systems maintain secure operation without depending on the trustworthiness of external entities.
classification_rationale: Self-reliant trustworthiness is a security design principle (ART-PRI) applied in secure development SD-05.01.

definition_short_en: Large language models may inadvertently reveal confidential data in their responses if outputs are not properly filtered, creating a data disclosure risk.
classification_rationale: Describes a risk of LLMs leaking confidential data, mapping to ART-RSK in data protection SD-02.04.

definition_short_en: Maintain a separate execution domain for each thread so that threads are isolated from one another, preventing interference and unauthorized cross-thread data access.
classification_rationale: Thread execution isolation is a technical preventive hardening control in SD-04.03.

definition_short_en: Obtain alternate telecommunications services from providers sufficiently separated from primary providers to reduce susceptibility to shared threats and single points of failure.
classification_rationale: Diverse alternate telecom providers support resilience/recovery, mapping to a recovery control in SD-07.04.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may purchase and configure serverless cloud infrastructure to support their operations during targeting, representing an infrastructure-based attacker technique.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique (serverless infrastructure acquisition), mapping to ART-THR in threat intel SD-06.05.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a current inventory of service providers to support oversight, risk assessment, and management of third-party relationships.
classification_rationale: Maintaining a service provider inventory is an organizational control supporting third-party risk in SD-08.03.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may stop or disable services on a system to render those services unavailable to legitimate users, disrupting operations and availability.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary service-disruption technique, mapping to ART-THR in threat intel SD-06.05.

definition_short_en: Verify that session cookies have the 'Secure' attribute set so they are only transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections, preventing interception in transit.
classification_rationale: Setting the Secure cookie attribute is a technical preventive application control verified via testing in SD-05.02.

definition_short_en: Verify that the application performs all session token verification using a trusted backend service rather than relying on client-side validation.
classification_rationale: Backend-only session token verification is a technical preventive application security control in SD-05.02.

definition_short_en: Automatically terminate a user session after a defined period of inactivity to limit exposure from unattended or abandoned authenticated sessions.
classification_rationale: Automatic session timeout on inactivity is a technical preventive authentication control in SD-03.02.

definition_short_en: Generate a unique, unpredictable session identifier for each session to prevent session prediction, fixation, and reuse across different users.
classification_rationale: Generating unique session identifiers is a technical preventive application session control in SD-05.02.

definition_short_en: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions to ensure that session participants and messages are genuine and not subject to hijacking or tampering.
classification_rationale: Protecting communications session authenticity is a technical preventive network security control in SD-04.01.

definition_short_en: Verify that when session termination is triggered, the application disallows any further use of the terminated session token or identifier.
classification_rationale: Ensuring terminated sessions cannot be reused is a technical preventive application session control in SD-05.02.

definition_short_en: Enforce a limit on consecutive invalid logon attempts to protect accounts against brute-force and credential-guessing attacks through lockout or throttling.
classification_rationale: Limiting consecutive invalid logons is a technical preventive authentication control against brute force in SD-03.02.

definition_short_en: Applications must enforce an inactivity timeout that triggers re-authentication based on documented risk analysis and security decisions, limiting exposure of unattended authenticated sessions.
classification_rationale: A technical safeguard enforcing session timeout and re-authentication; session management maps to authentication sub-domain.

title_en: Clear Authenticated Data After Session End
definition_short_en: Applications must clear authenticated data from client-side storage once the client or session is terminated, preventing residual sensitive data from being accessed afterward.
classification_rationale: Technical control clearing authenticated client storage at session termination; session management under authentication.

definition_short_en: All WebSocket connections must use WebSocket over TLS (WSS) to protect data in transit from interception, ensuring encrypted communication channels for real-time application traffic.
classification_rationale: Technical control mandating encrypted transport (WSS) for WebSocket connections; communications security domain.

definition_short_en: Information must be disposed of, destroyed, or erased once its defined retention period expires, minimizing exposure of data that is no longer required to be kept.
classification_rationale: Control enforcing secure disposal at end of retention; maps to privacy, retention and disposal sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Personnel must receive training to recognize and report potential and actual social engineering and social mining attempts, strengthening human resilience against manipulation-based attacks.
classification_rationale: Human control providing awareness training on social engineering; awareness and training sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Systems processing Social Security numbers must eliminate unnecessary collection, maintenance, and use of these identifiers, reducing privacy risk and exposure of sensitive personal data.
classification_rationale: Data minimization control for SSNs; privacy and personal data handling under privacy/retention sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Enterprises must establish and maintain a detailed inventory of all licensed software installed on enterprise assets, enabling license compliance and detection of unauthorized software.
classification_rationale: Control maintaining a software inventory; maps to software and license sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The organization must maintain an inventory of system components, providing visibility into deployed assets to support security management, patching, and configuration control.
classification_rationale: Control maintaining an inventory of system components; asset inventory sub-domain.

title_en: Inventory of Managed Software and Systems
definition_short_en: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization must be maintained, ensuring comprehensive visibility of managed technology assets across the enterprise.
classification_rationale: Control maintaining inventories of managed software, services, and systems; asset inventory sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse software extensions to establish persistent access to victim systems, representing a threat technique that defenders must detect and mitigate.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique (software extension abuse for persistence); a threat rather than a control.

definition_short_en: Software must be maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk, ensuring outdated or unsupported components are addressed proportionately to the threat they present.
classification_rationale: A risk-based outcome requiring software maintenance, replacement, and removal; requirement under software lifecycle management.

definition_short_en: The organization must establish restrictions governing software usage, defining what software may be installed and used to reduce risk from unauthorized or unsafe applications.
classification_rationale: A governing statement establishing software usage restrictions; policy under software and license sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse the Windows Task Scheduler to schedule initial or recurring execution of malicious code, a technique used for persistence and execution.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique abusing Task Scheduler for malicious execution; a threat entry.

definition_short_en: Adversaries can hide a program's true filetype by altering its extension, a masquerading technique used to disguise malicious files as benign ones.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary masquerading technique via file extension manipulation; a threat entry.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may employ known symmetric encryption algorithms to conceal command and control traffic, evading detection by hiding malicious communications within encrypted channels.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique using encryption to hide C2 traffic; a threat entry.

definition_short_en: Strategic direction describing appropriate risk response options must be established and communicated, aligning organizational risk-handling choices with leadership intent and governance objectives.
classification_rationale: A governance outcome requiring strategic direction on risk response; risk management sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity must execute an action plan to implement its cybersecurity strategy, translating strategic goals into concrete activities and measurable progress across the program.
classification_rationale: A governance requirement to execute a strategy action plan; strategy and governance sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes must be reviewed to inform and adjust the strategy and direction, enabling continuous improvement based on realized results.
classification_rationale: A governance requirement to review risk strategy outcomes and adjust direction; risk management sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The entity's cybersecurity strategy must be identified, documented, and approved, establishing a formal, authorized foundation for the organization's security program and direction.
classification_rationale: A governance requirement mandating a documented and approved cybersecurity strategy; strategy and governance sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The cybersecurity strategy must be reviewed at planned intervals or when relevant legislative and regulatory requirements change, keeping it current with evolving obligations and conditions.
classification_rationale: A governance requirement to review the strategy at intervals or on regulatory change; strategy and governance sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The registration process for granting logical access accounts must require supervisor or sponsor authorization, ensuring provisioning is approved by an accountable party before access is granted.
classification_rationale: Control requiring supervisor approval in account registration; identity lifecycle provisioning sub-domain.

definition_short_en: The organization must develop, document, and implement a supply chain risk management plan to systematically address risks arising from suppliers, products, and third-party services.
classification_rationale: Requires developing and implementing a supply chain risk management plan; third-party and supply risk sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Risks posed by suppliers, their products and services, and other third parties must be understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored throughout the relationship.
classification_rationale: Control for lifecycle assessment and monitoring of supplier risk; third-party and supply risk sub-domain. Bundles multiple activities.

definition_short_en: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software must be assessed prior to acquisition and use, protecting against counterfeit or tampered components entering the supply chain.
classification_rationale: Control assessing authenticity and integrity of hardware/software before use; supply chain risk sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Suppliers of critical or mission-essential technologies, products, and services must be identified, prioritized, and assessed, focusing supply chain risk efforts on the most consequential relationships.
classification_rationale: Control identifying and prioritizing critical suppliers for assessment; third-party and supply risk sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Establish and maintain a formal program to identify, assess, and manage cybersecurity risks arising from suppliers and the broader supply chain throughout their lifecycle.
classification_rationale: A standing organizational program governing supply chain risk maps to ART-PRG at governance abstraction within third-party and supply risk.

definition_short_en: Restrict usage to only fully supported and enterprise-approved web browsers and email clients, preventing reliance on unsupported or unauthorized client software.
classification_rationale: A preventive technical safeguard constraining permitted browser and email client software falls under email, web and digital communications security.

definition_short_en: Ensure that only currently vendor-supported software and software components remain in use across the enterprise, retiring or replacing end-of-life products that no longer receive patches.
classification_rationale: Retaining only supported, patchable software is a preventive control tied to vulnerability and patch management.

definition_short_en: Employ mechanisms and analysis to verify the integrity and pedigree of the system and its components, detecting tampering or counterfeit parts within the supply chain.
classification_rationale: Verifying integrity and pedigree of components is a detective safeguard mapping to code, components and supply chain security.

definition_short_en: Implement IEEE 802.1X port-based network access control on switches and limit the number of MAC addresses permitted per port to prevent unauthorized device connections.
classification_rationale: Port-based NAC and MAC limiting are preventive technical network security controls.

definition_short_en: Segment network traffic using VLANs, isolate unused ports in a quarantine VLAN, and enable BPDU Guard to protect the spanning-tree topology from disruption.
classification_rationale: VLAN segmentation and BPDU Guard are preventive technical network security controls at switch level.

definition_short_en: Synchronize system clocks within and between systems and components against an authoritative time source to ensure consistent, correlatable timestamps for logs and events.
classification_rationale: Clock synchronization underpins reliable log correlation, mapping to logging and monitoring as a supporting technical control.

definition_short_en: Adversaries perform system checks to detect virtualization, sandbox, or analysis environments and alter behavior to evade detection and defensive inspection.
classification_rationale: This describes an adversary evasion technique, classified as a threat at risk abstraction under threat detection.

definition_short_en: Develop and implement a system development life cycle that embeds security and privacy considerations across all phases from requirements through disposal.
classification_rationale: A defined SDLC integrating security is a process at procedural abstraction under AppSec governance and SDLC.

definition_short_en: Verify that critical system files such as passwd, shadow, and group have correct root ownership and strict permissions to prevent unauthorized modification.
classification_rationale: Enforcing ownership and permissions on system files is a preventive hardening control under configuration and hardening.

definition_short_en: Configure and manage system components securely in accordance with industry-accepted hardening standards to reduce the attack surface and eliminate insecure defaults.
classification_rationale: Applying hardening standards to system components is a preventive technical control under configuration and hardening.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may abuse the systemctl utility to execute commands, launch programs, or manipulate services on Linux systems to achieve persistence or execution.
classification_rationale: An adversary execution technique abusing systemctl is a threat at risk abstraction under threat detection.

definition_short_en: Connect and configure individual intrusion detection tools into an integrated, system-wide intrusion detection capability providing correlated visibility across the environment.
classification_rationale: Integrating IDS tools into a unified detection system is a detective technical control under threat detection and alerts.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may deliver malicious payloads to remote systems by adding tainted content to shared storage locations that other users or systems access.
classification_rationale: Tainting shared content for lateral payload delivery is an adversary technique, classified as a threat under threat detection.

definition_short_en: Plan for and implement a scheduled technology refresh for the system and its components throughout the system development life cycle to avoid obsolescence.
classification_rationale: A scheduled technology refresh plan for systems is a plan at procedural abstraction under systems, servers and endpoint.

definition_short_en: Employ testing and analysis of supply chain elements, processes, and actors to detect weaknesses, tampering, or malicious involvement before and during procurement.
classification_rationale: Testing and analyzing supply chain elements and actors is a detective organizational control under third-party and supply risk.

definition_short_en: Test malicious code protection mechanisms by introducing known benign test code into the system to confirm detection and response functionality operates correctly.
classification_rationale: Validating anti-malware mechanisms with benign test code is a detective control under security testing and assessments.

definition_short_en: Test, validate, and document changes to the system before finalizing implementation to confirm they function correctly and introduce no adverse security impact.
classification_rationale: Testing, validating, and documenting changes before finalization is a process under change and release management.

definition_short_en: Technology assets are protected from environmental threats such as fire, flood, temperature, and power failure through appropriate physical and environmental safeguards.
classification_rationale: Protecting assets from environmental hazards is a preventive physical control under physical and environmental security.

definition_short_en: Conduct an organizational risk assessment prior to acquiring or outsourcing information security services to understand exposure introduced by the third party.
classification_rationale: Assessing risk before acquiring or outsourcing security services is a preventive organizational control under third-party risk.

definition_short_en: Conduct an organizational risk assessment before the acquisition or outsourcing of information security services to identify and mitigate associated third-party risks.
classification_rationale: Pre-outsourcing risk assessment is a preventive organizational control under third-party risk; duplicates 0694 in intent.

definition_short_en: Cybersecurity requirements for contracts and agreements with third parties must be identified, documented, and formally approved before engagement.
classification_rationale: A mandated outcome that cybersecurity contract requirements be identified and approved is a contractual requirement under legal, HR and contracts.

definition_short_en: Contracts with third parties providing IT or cybersecurity outsourcing must require conducting a cybersecurity risk assessment as a defined contractual obligation.
classification_rationale: A conditional contractual requirement applying to IT/cyber outsourcing agreements maps to a contractual requirement under third-party risk.

definition_short_en: Establish lines of communication across the organization for cybersecurity risks, including those arising from suppliers and other third parties, to enable coordinated response.
classification_rationale: Establishing communication channels for supplier and third-party cyber risk is an organizational control under third-party and supply risk.

definition_short_en: Verify that application documentation defines risk-based remediation timeframes for third-party component versions found to contain known vulnerabilities.
classification_rationale: Defining risk-based remediation timeframes for vulnerable third-party components is a corrective control under code, components and supply chain.

definition_short_en: Establish an organizational threat awareness program that includes a cross-organization capability for sharing and receiving threat intelligence to inform defenders and improve collective security posture.
classification_rationale: A named program providing threat awareness and cross-org intelligence sharing maps to ART-PRG in the threat intelligence sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Receive cyber threat intelligence from external information-sharing forums and trusted sources to maintain current awareness of emerging adversary tactics, indicators, and campaigns affecting the organization.
classification_rationale: An organizational safeguard consuming external threat feeds is a detective control in the threat intelligence sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Gather and analyze collected threat intelligence to derive actionable insights that inform security decisions, prioritization, and defensive measures across the organization's protection efforts.
classification_rationale: Gathering and analyzing intelligence to inform decisions is an ongoing process in the threat intel sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Adversaries may duplicate and impersonate another user's existing access token to escalate privileges and assume that user's security context on a compromised system.
classification_rationale: Describes an adversary technique of stealing tokens to escalate privilege, so it is a threat in the privileged access sub-domain.

definition_short_en: Verify that self-contained tokens are validated using their digital signature or message authentication code to protect against tampering and forgery before they are trusted.
classification_rationale: Technical preventive control validating token integrity via signature/MAC belongs to authentication.

definition_short_en: Adversaries modify machine learning training data so the model learns incorrect behavior, degrading integrity of AI outputs and introducing exploitable biases or backdoors into deployed systems.
classification_rationale: Training data manipulation causing incorrect model behavior is an AI supply-chain threat.

definition_short_en: Tampering with training data supplied through people or third parties introduces vulnerabilities or biases into the large language model, corrupting its behavior and trustworthiness.
classification_rationale: Same poisoning threat framed through third-party/personnel data supply, mapping to third-party supply risk.

definition_short_en: Verify that individuals or systems transferring data between interconnected systems hold the requisite authorizations, such as write permissions, before the receiving system accepts and processes such data.
classification_rationale: Checking write authorization before accepting transferred data is a preventive authorization/least-privilege control.

definition_short_en: Associate security and privacy attributes with information exchanged between systems and system components so downstream handling enforces the correct classification and protection policies during transmission.
classification_rationale: Binding security/privacy attributes to exchanged data is a data-classification labeling control.

definition_short_en: Integrate the characteristics of trustworthy artificial intelligence into organizational policies so governance formally requires fairness, transparency, safety, and accountability across AI system development and use.
classification_rationale: A governing statement embedding trustworthy AI traits into organizational policy maps to ART-POL under policies/standards.

definition_short_en: Apply the security design principle of hierarchical trust, structuring components so trust flows in defined tiers and no component grants more trust than its parent authorizes.
classification_rationale: A secure design principle guiding component trust architecture maps to ART-PRI in AppSec governance/SDLC.

definition_short_en: Prohibit direct connection of unclassified national security systems to an external network unless boundary protection devices mediate and control the traffic crossing that trust boundary.
classification_rationale: Requiring boundary protection devices before external connectivity is a preventive network security control.
